text: Arduratuta daude, gripearen sintomak arinak direnean eta pazienteek eguneroko bizitza egiten dutenean pertsona gehiago infektatzeko aukera egongo delako.
eng_text: There is concern that patients may continue to infect more people by going through their daily routines if the flu symptoms remain mild.

text: Komen Fundazioko Leslie Aun bozeramaileak esan duenez, erakundeak arau berri bat jarri du abian, lege-ikerketa abian duten erakundeei bekak edo dirulaguntzak emateko aukera debekatzen duena.
eng_text: Leslie Aun, a spokesperson for the Komen Foundation, said the organization adopted a new rule that does not allow grants or funding to be awarded to organizations that are under legal investigation.

text: Komen-en gidalerro horrek Planned Parenthood deskalifikatu egin zuen, Planned Parenthood-ek dirua nola gastatzen duen eta horren berri nola ematen duen ikertzen ari delako Cliff Stearns ordezkaria.
eng_text: Komen's policy disqualified Planned Parenthood due to a pending investigation on how Planned Parenthood spends and reports its money that is being conducted by Representative Cliff Stearns.

text: Planned Parenthood bidez abortuak ordaintzeko zergak erabiltzen ari ote diren argitzeko lanean ari da Stearns, Omisio eta Ikerketen Azpibatzordeko burua den aldetik (Gobernuko Energia eta Merkataritza Batzordearen barruan dago erakundea).
eng_text: Stearns is investigating whether taxes are used to fund abortions through Planned Parenthood in his role as chairman of the Oversight and Investigations Subcommittee, which is under the umbrella of the House Energy and Commerce Committee.

text: Massachusetts-eko gobernadore izandako Mitt Romney-k irabazi zuen Floridako Alderdi Errepublikanoaren presidentetzarako hauteskunde primarioa, botoen ehuneko 46 jasota.
eng_text: Former Massachusetts governor Mitt Romney won the Florida Republican Party presidential primary election on Tuesday with over 46 percent of the vote.

text: AEBetako Gobernuko Bozeramaile izandako Newt Gingrich bigarren geratu zen botoen ehuneko 32 jasota.
eng_text: Former U.S. Speaker of the House Newt Gingrich came in second with 32 percent.

text: “Irabazleak osoa hartzen du” erako antolamendua duen estatua denez, Floridak Romney-ri eman zizkion berrogeita hamar delegatuak, eta, hala, nagusi da Alderdi Errepublikanoko buru izateko izendapenerako bidean.
eng_text: As a winner-takes-all state, Florida awarded all fifty of its delegates to Romney, pushing him ahead as the front-runner for the Republican Party nomination.

eng_text: Organisers of the protest said about 100,000 people turned up in German cities such as Berlin, Cologne, Hamburg, and Hanover.

eng_text: In London, about 200 people protested outside some major copyright holders' offices.

eng_text: Last month, there were major protests in Poland when that country signed ACTA, which has led to the Polish government deciding not to ratify the agreement, for now.

eng_text: Latvia and Slovakia have both delayed the process of joining ACTA.

eng_text: Animal Liberation and the Royal Society for the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals (RSPCA) are again calling for the mandatory installation of CCTV cameras in all Australian abattoirs.

text: Hegoaldeko Gales Berriko RSPCAko inspektore nagusi David O'Shannessy-k esan dio ABCri hiltegien zaintza eta ikuskapenek ohiko izan beharko luketela Australian.
eng_text: RSPCA New South Wales chief inspector David O'Shannessy told the ABC that surveillance and inspections of abattoirs should be commonplace in Australia.

eng_text: "The CCTV would certainly send a strong signal to those people working with animals that their welfare is of the highest priority."

eng_text: The United States Geological Survey international earthquake map showed no earthquakes in Iceland in the week prior.

eng_text: The clouds presented the potential for confusion as to whether an actual eruption had taken place.

eng_text: The failure of the second sentence, which proposes to ban same-sex civil unions, could possibly open the door for civil unions in the future.

eng_text: Following the process, HJR-3 will be reviewed again by the next elected legislature in either 2015 or 2016 to remain in process.

eng_text: Vautier's achievements outside of directing include a hunger strike in 1973 against what he viewed as political censorship.

eng_text: The cause of death was announced as intrahepatic bile duct cancer.

eng_text: He died in Osaka on Tuesday.

eng_text: As well as a former Olympic and World champion, Saito was the All Japan Judo Federation training committee chairman at the time of his death.

eng_text: At least 100 people had attended the party, in order to celebrate the first anniversary of a couple whose wedding was held last year.

eng_text: A formal anniversary event was scheduled for a later date, officials said.

eng_text: The couple had married in Texas one year ago and came to Buffalo to celebrate with friends and relatives.

eng_text: Karno is a well-known but controversial English tutor who taught under Modern Education and King's Glory who claimed to have 9,000 students at the peak of his career.

eng_text: In his notes he used words which some parents considered coarse, and he reportedly used profanity in class.

eng_text: Modern Education accused him of printing large advertisements on buses without authorisation and lying by saying that he was the chief English tutor.

text: Halaber, copyright-eskubideak urratzea ere leporatu diote, baina ez da kargurik aurkeztu.
eng_text: He has also been accused previously of copyright infringement, but was not charged.

eng_text: A former student said that he 'used slang in class, taught dating skills in notes, and was just like the students' friend.'

eng_text: During the last three decades, despite officially remaining a communist state, China has developed a market economy.

text: Deng Xiaoping-en gidaritzapean egin ziren lehen erreforma ekonomikoak.
eng_text: The first economic reforms were made under the leadership of Deng Xiaoping.

text: Ordutik, 90 aldiz hazi da Txinaren tamaina ekonomikoa.
eng_text: Since then, China's economic size has grown by 90 times.

eng_text: For the first time, last year China exported more cars than Germany and surpassed the United States as the biggest market for this industry.

text: Txinako BPG Estatu Batuena baino handiagoa izan daiteke bi hamarkada barru.
eng_text: China's GDP could be larger than the United States within two decades.

text: Danielle ekaitz tropikala, 2010eko Atlantikoko urakan-denboraldian izendatutako laugarren ekaitza, sortu da Ozeano Atlantikoaren ekialdean.
eng_text: Tropical Storm Danielle, fourth named storm of the 2010 Atlantic hurricane season, has formed in the eastern Atlantic Ocean.

text: Miamitik (Florida) 3.000 milia ingurura kokatutako ekaitzak orduko 40 mph-ko (64 kph) abiadura maximoa duen haize jarraitua du.
eng_text: The storm, located approximately 3,000 miles from Miami, Florida, has maximum sustained winds of 40 mph (64 kph).

text: Urakanen Zentro Nazionaleko zientzialariek aurreikusi dutenez, Danielle indartu eta urakan bihurtuko da asteazkenean.
eng_text: Scientists at the National Hurricane Center predict that Danielle will strengthen to a hurricane by Wednesday.

text: Ekaitza lurra jotzetik urrun dagoenez, zaila da Estatu Batuetan edo Kariben inpakturik izango duen edo ez ebaluatzea.
eng_text: As the storm is far from landfall, it remains difficult to assess potential impact to the United States or Caribbean.

eng_text: Born in the Croatian capital, Zagreb, Bobek gained fame while playing for Partizan Belgrade.

text: 1945ean hasi zen haiekin jokatzen, eta 1958 arte jarraitu zuen bertan.
eng_text: He joined them in 1945 and stayed until 1958.

eng_text: During his time with the team, he scored 403 goals in 468 appearances.

eng_text: No one else has ever made more appearances or scored more goals for the club than Bobek.

text: 1995ean, Partizan-en historiako jokalaririk onena izendatu zuten.
eng_text: In 1995 he was voted the best player in Partizan's history.

eng_text: The celebrations started with a special show by the world-renowned group Cirque du Soleil.

eng_text: It was followed by the Istanbul State Symphony Orchestra, a Janissary band, and the singers Fatih Erkoç and Müslüm Gürses.

eng_text: Then Whirling Dervishes took to the stage.

eng_text: Turkish diva Sezen Aksu performed with the Italian tenor Alessandro Safina and Greek singer Haris Alexiou.

eng_text: To finish, Turkish dance group Fire of Anatolia performed the show "Troy".

text: Peter Lenz 13 urteko motor-lasterkaria hil egin da Indianapolis-eko Motor Speedway-en istripu bat izan ondoren.
eng_text: Peter Lenz, a 13-year-old motorcycle racer, has died after being involved in a crash at the Indianapolis Motor Speedway.

text: Berotzeko bira egiten ari zen bitartean, Lenz mototik erori eta lasterketako kide Xavier Zayat-ek jo zuen.
eng_text: While on his warm-up lap, Lenz fell off his bike, and was then struck by fellow racer Xavier Zayat.

text: Lasterketako medikuek artatu zuten berehala eta tokiko ospitalera eraman zuten, eta han hil zen beranduago.
eng_text: He was immediately attended to by the on-track medical staff and transported to a local hospital where he later died.

text: Zayat-ek ez zuen zauririk izan istripuaren ondorioz.
eng_text: Zayat was unhurt in the accident.

text: Munduko egoera finantzarioari dagokionez, Zapatero-k jarraitu zuen esanez “sistema finantzarioa ekonomiaren parte dela, oinarrizko parte bat.
eng_text: Regarding the global financial situation, Zapatero continued by saying that "the financial system is a part of the economy, a crucial part.

text: Krisi finantzarioak urte osoa iraun du, eta duela bi hilabete izan zen unerik larriena; uste dut orain hasi direla berreskuratzen merkatu finantzarioak.”
eng_text: We have a year-long financial crisis, which has had its most acute moment in the past two months, and I think now the financial markets are beginning to recover."

eng_text: Last week, Naked News announced that it would dramatically increase its international language mandate to news reporting, with three new broadcasts.

eng_text: Already reporting in English and Japanese, the global organization is launching Spanish, Italian, and Korean-language programs, for television, the web, and mobile devices.

text: Zorionez, niri ez zait ezer gertatu baina egoera makabroa bizi izan dut, jendea irteteko asmoz leihoak apurtzen saiatu denean.
eng_text: "Luckily nothing happened to me, but I saw a macabre scene, as people tried to break windows in order to get out.

text: Aulkiekin jotzen zituzten leihoak, baina beira hauskaitza da.
eng_text: People were hitting the panes with chairs, but the windows were unbreakable.

eng_text: One of the panes finally broke, and they started to get out by the window," said survivor Franciszek Kowal.

text: Izarrek argia eta beroa igortzen dute, hidrogeno atomoak elementu astunagoak sortzeko elkartzen (edo fusionatzen) direnean askatzen den energiagatik.
eng_text: Stars give off light and heat because of the energy made when hydrogen atoms are merged (or fused) together to form heavier elements.

text: Energia modu berean sortuko duen erreaktore bat egiteko lanean ari dira zientzialariak.
eng_text: Scientists are working to create a reactor that can make energy in the same way.

text: Hala ere, ebazteko zaila da arazo hori, eta urte asko beharko dira fusio-erreaktore erabilgarriak eraikitzen hasi aurretik.
eng_text: This, however, is a very hard problem to solve and will take many years before we see useful fusion reactors built.

text: Altzairuzko orratzak gainazaleko tentsioagatik flotatzen du uraren gainean.
eng_text: The steel needle floats on top of the water because of surface tension.

text: Gainazaleko tentsioa gertatzen da uraren azaleko ur molekulek elkarrekiko erakarpen handiagoa dutelako gainean duten aire molekulekiko baino.
eng_text: Surface tension happens because the water molecules at the surface of the water are strongly attracted to each other more than they are to the air molecules above them.

text: Ur molekulek geruza ikusezin bat osatzen dute uraren gainazalean, eta horri esker flotatzen dute orratzek eta antzeko objektuek uraren gainean.
eng_text: The water molecules make an invisible skin on the water’s surface that allows things like the needle to float on top of the water.

text: Izotzetako patin modernoaren ahoak ertz bikoitza du eta hutsune konkaboa tartean. Bi ertzei esker, izotza hobeto harrapatzen da, baita okertzean ere.
eng_text: The blade on a modern ice skate has a double edge with a concave hollow between them. The two edges allow for a better grasp of the ice, even when tilted.

text: Ahoaren beheko zatia apur bat kurbatua denez, ahoa alde batera edo bestera okertzean, izotzarekin kontaktuan dagoen ertza ere kurbatu egiten da.
eng_text: Because the bottom of the blade is slightly curved, as the blade tilts to one side or the other, the edge which is in contact with the ice also curves.

text: Horren eraginez, patinatzaileak biratu egiten du. Patina eskuinerantz okertzen bada, patinatzaileak eskuinerantz biratzen du, eta ezkerrerantz okertzen bada, berriz, patinatzaileak ezkerrerantz biratzen du.
eng_text: This causes the skater to turn. If the skates tilt to the right, the skater turns right, if the skates tilt to the left, the skater turns left.

text: Aurreko energia-mailara itzultzeko, argitik jaso duten energia gehigarria askatu behar dute.
eng_text: To return to their previous energy level, they must get rid of the extra energy they got from the light.

text: Hori egiteko, “fotoi” izeneko argi partikula txikia igortzen dute.
eng_text: They do this by emitting a tiny particle of light called a "photon".

text: Zientzialariek “erradiazio-igorpen estimulatu” deitzen diote prozesuari, argi distiratsuak atomoak estimulatu egiten dituelako, eta, horren eraginez, argi fotoi bat igortzen delako. Argia erradiazio mota bat da.
eng_text: Scientists call this process "stimulated emission of radiation" because the atoms are stimulated by the bright light, causing the emission of a photon of light, and light is a type of radiation.

text: Jarraian ageri den irudian fotoiak igortzen ari diren atomoak ikus daitezke. Nola ez, errealitatean fotoiak irudikoak baino askoz txikiagoak dira.
eng_text: The next picture shows the atoms emitting photons. Of course, in reality photons are a lot smaller than those in the picture.

text: Fotoiak atomoa osatzen duten gaiak baino txikiagoak dira!
eng_text: Photons are even smaller than the stuff that makes up atoms!

text: Ehunka orduz jardun ondoren, bonbillako haria erre egiten da eta bonbillak funtzionatzeari uzten dio.
eng_text: After hundreds of hours of operation the filament in the bulb eventually burns out and the light bulb no longer works.

text: Orduan bonbilla ordezkatu beharra dago. Kontuz ordezkatu behar da bonbilla.
eng_text: The light bulb then needs replacing. It is necessary to be careful in replacing the light bulb.

text: Hasteko, argia ematen duen altzariaren etengailuak itzalita egon behar du, edo kableak entxufetik aterata.
eng_text: First, the switch for the light fixture needs to be turned off or the cable disconnected.

text: Hori egin behar da bonbillaren zati metalikoa jartzen den gunearen barrualdea edo bonbillaren metalezko oinarria ukitzen badituzu, elektrizitateak shock elektrikoa eragin diezazukeelako, bonbilla gunean erdi-sartuta dagoenean.
eng_text: This is because electricity flowing into the socket where the metallic part of bulb sits can give you a severe electric shock if you touch the inside of the socket or the metal base of the bulb while it is still partly in the socket.

text: Zirkulazio-sistemaren organo nagusia bihotza da, eta odola ponpatzen du.
eng_text: The major organ of the circulatory system is the heart, which pumps the blood.

text: Odola bihotzetik ateratzen da arteria izeneko hodietatik eta zain izeneko hodietatik itzultzen da bihotzera. Hodirik txikienei kapilar deritze.
eng_text: Blood goes away from the heart in tubes called arteries and comes back to the heart in tubes called veins. The smallest tubes are called capillaries.

text: Trizeratopsen haginak gai ziren hostoak txikitzeko, baina baita adar eta sustrai sendoak txikitzeko ere.
eng_text: A triceratops' teeth would have been able to crush not only leaves but even very tough branches and roots.

text: Zientzialari batzuek uste dute trizeratopsek zikadak jaten zituztela, kretazeoan ohikoak ziren landare mota bat.
eng_text: Some scientists think Triceratops ate cycads, which are a type of plant that was common in the Cretaceous.

text: Palmondo txiki baten antza dute landare horiek, eta goiko zatian hosto zorrotz eta arantzatsuak dituzte.
eng_text: These plants look like a small palm tree with a crown of sharp, spiky leaves.

text: Baliteke trizeratopsek beren moko indartsua erabiltzea enborra jan aurretik hostoak kentzeko.
eng_text: A Triceratops could have used its strong beak to strip off the leaves before eating the trunk.

text: Beste zientzialari batzuek esaten dute landare horiek oso pozoitsuak direla eta ziurrenez ez zegoela haiek jaten zituen dinosaurorik, nahiz eta, gaur egun, nagiak eta beste animalia batzuek, loroek esaterako (dinosauroen ondorengoetako batek), hosto edo fruitu pozoitsuak jan ditzaketen.
eng_text: Other scientists argue that these plants are very poisonous so it is unlikely that any dinosaur ate them, even though today the sloth and other animals like the parrot (a descendant of the dinosaurs) can eat poisonous leaves or fruit.

text: Nola eragingo lidake Io-ko grabitateak? Io-ren gainazalean zutik egongo bazina, Lurrean pisatzen duzuna baino gutxiago pisatuko zenuke.
eng_text: How would Io's gravity pull on me? If you stood on the surface of Io, you would weigh less than you do on Earth.

text: Lurrean 200 libra (90 kg) pisatzen dituen pertsonak 36 libra (16 kg) inguru pisatuko lituzke Io-n. Beraz, grabitateak gutxiago tiratuko zintuzke.
eng_text: A person who weighs 200 pounds (90kg) on Earth would weigh about 36 pounds (16kg) on Io. So the gravity, of course, pulls less on you.

text: Eguzkiak ez du, Lurrak bezala, zutik egoteko aukera ematen duen azalik. Eguzki osoa gasez, suz eta plasmaz eginda dago.
eng_text: The Sun doesn't have a crust like the Earth that you can stand on. The whole Sun is made out of gases, fire, and plasma.

text: Gasa mehetu egiten da Eguzkiaren erdigunetik zenbat eta urrunago egon.
eng_text: The gas becomes thinner as you go farther from the center of the Sun.

text: Eguzkira begiratzean ikusten dugun kanpoko zatiari fotosfera deritzo, zeinak “argi-bola” esan nahi baitu.
eng_text: The outer-part we see when we look at the Sun is called the photosphere, which means "ball of light".

text: Hiru mila urte beranduago, 1610ean, Galileo Galilei astronomo italiarrak teleskopio bat erabili zuen Artizarrak faseak dituela behatzeko, Ilargiak dituen era berean.
eng_text: About three thousand years later, in 1610, Italian astronomer Galileo Galilei used a telescope to observe that Venus has phases, just as the moon does.

text: Faseak gertatzen dira Eguzkira begira dagoen Artizarraren (edo Ilargiaren) aldea soilik dagoelako argiztatuta. Artizarreko faseek Koperniko-ren teoria bermatzen zuten, zeinak esaten baitzuen planetek Eguzkiaren inguruan biratzen dutela.
eng_text: Phases happen because only the side of Venus (or of the Moon) facing the Sun is lighted. The phases of Venus supported the theory of Copernicus that the planets go around the Sun.

text: Ondoren, urte batzuk beranduago, 1639ean, Jeremiah Horrocks izeneko astronomo ingeles batek Artizarraren trantsitu bat behatu zuen.
eng_text: Then, a few years later in 1639, an English astronomer named Jeremiah Horrocks observed a transit of Venus.

text: Ingalaterrak bake garai luzea bizi izan zuen Danelaw berreskuratu ondoren.
eng_text: England had experienced a long period of peace after the reconquest of the Danelaw.

text: Hala ere, 991. urtean Ethelredek bikingoen flota bati aurre egin behar izan zion, mende bat lehenago egondako Guthrum-en flotaz geroztik izandako flotarik handienari.
eng_text: However in 991 Ethelred was faced with a Viking fleet larger than any since Guthrum's a century earlier.

text: Flotak Olaf Trygvasson zuen buru, bere herria daniarren eskuetatik askatu nahi izan zuen asmo handiko norvegiarra.
eng_text: This fleet was led by Olaf Trygvasson, a Norwegian with ambitions to reclaim his country from Danish domination.

text: Hasierako ezbehar militarren ondoren, Ethelredek adostasuna lortu zuen Olafekin, eta azken hori Norvegiara itzuli zen bere erresuma irabazteko asmoz, baina ez zuen guztiz lortu.
eng_text: After initial military setbacks, Ethelred was able to agree to terms with Olaf, who returned to Norway to try to gain his kingdom with mixed success.

text: Hangul da berariaz asmatutako alfabetoetatik egunerokoan erabiltzen den bakarra. 1444an asmatu zen alfabetoa, Sejong erregearen erregealdian (1418 - 1450).
eng_text: Hangeul is the only purposely invented alphabet in popular daily use. The alphabet was invented in 1444 during the reign of King Sejong (1418 – 1450).

text: Sejong erregea Joseon dinastiako laugarren erregea izan zen, eta estimatuenetako bat da.
eng_text: King Sejong was the fourth king of the Joseon Dynasty and is one of the most highly regarded.

text: Hasieran, Hangul alfabetoari Hunmin Jeongeum izena jarri zion, hau da, “jendearen argibideetarako soinu zuzenak”.
eng_text: He originally named the Hangeul alphabet Hunmin Jeongeum, which means "the correct sounds for the instruction of the people".

text: Sanskritoaren sorrerari buruzko teoria asko daude. Horietako batek dio ariarren migrazio bat egon zela mendebaldetik Indiara eta haien hizkuntza eraman zutela berekin.
eng_text: There are many theories to how Sanskrit came into existence. One of them is about an Aryan migration from the west into India who brought their language with them.

text: Sanskritoa antzinako hizkuntza bat da, eta Europan hitz egin zen latinaren baliokidea da.
eng_text: Sanskrit is an ancient language and is comparable to the Latin language spoken in Europe.

text: Munduan ezagutzen den lehen liburua sanskritoz idatzita zegoen. Upanishad-ak jaso ondoren, sanskritoa desagertu egin zen hierarkia dela eta.
eng_text: The earliest known book in the world was written in Sanskrit. After the compilation of Upanishads, Sanskrit just faded due to hierarchy.

text: Sanskritoa oso hizkuntza konplexu eta aberatsa da, eta Indiako hizkuntza moderno askoren iturria izan da, latina Europako hizkuntza askoren (esaterako, frantsesaren edo gaztelaniaren) iturri den era berean.
eng_text: Sanskrit is a very complex and rich language, which has served to be the source for many modern Indian languages, just like Latin is the source for European languages like French and Spanish.

text: Frantzia eskuratzeko bataila amaitzean, britainiar uhartea inbaditzeko prestatzen hasi zen Alemania.
eng_text: With the battle for France over, Germany began to get ready to invade the island of Britain.

text: Alemanek “Itsas txakur operazioa” kode-izena eman zioten erasoari. Britainiar Armadako arma astun eta hornikuntza gehienak galdu egin ziren Dunkerque-tik ebakuatzean, eta, beraz, armada nahiko ahula zen.
eng_text: Germany code-named the attack “Operation Sealion”. Most of the British Army's heavy weapons and supplies had been lost when it evacuated from Dunkirk, so the army was fairly weak.

text: Baina Alemaniako Marina (“Kriegsmarine”) baino indartsuagoa zen oraindik Errege Marina, eta Mantxako kanalean zehar bidalitako edozein inbasio-flota suntsitzeko gai zen.
eng_text: But the Royal Navy was still much stronger than the German Navy (“Kriegsmarine”) and could have destroyed any invasion fleet sent across the English Channel.

text: Hala ere, Errege Marinako itsasontzi gutxi zeuden inbasiorako probabilitate gehien zituzten ibilbideetan, alemaniarren aire-erasoen eraginez hondoratzeko beldur baitziren almiranteak.
eng_text: However, very few Royal Navy ships were based near the likely invasion routes as the admirals were afraid they would be sunk by German air attack.

text: Has gaitezen Italiako planen azalpenarekin. Italia Alemaniaren eta Japoniaren “anaia txikia” zen, batez ere.
eng_text: Let's start with an explanation about Italy's plans. Italy was mainly the "little brother" of Germany and Japan.

text: Armada eta marina ahulagoa zituen, nahiz eta gerra hasi baino lehen itsasontzi berriak eraiki.
eng_text: It had a weaker army and a weaker navy, although they had just built four new ships right before the beginning of the war.

text: Italiaren helburu nagusia Afrikako herrialdeak ziren. Herrialde horiek harrapatzeko, tropak bidaltzeko gune bat behar zuten, Mediterraneo itsasoa zeharkatu eta Afrika inbaditu ahal izateko.
eng_text: Italy's main goals were African countries. To capture those countries, they would need to have a troop launching pad, so as troops could sail across the Mediterranean Sea and invade Africa.

text: Horretarako, Egipto zeuden base eta itsasontzi britainiarrez libratu beharra zuten. Ekintza horietaz gain, Italiako armadako itsasontziek ez zuten beste ezer egin behar.
eng_text: For that, they had to get rid of British bases and ships in Egypt. Besides those actions, Italy's battleships were not supposed to do anything else.

text: Orain, goazen Japoniarekin. Japonia uharte bat da, Britainia bezala.
eng_text: Now for Japan. Japan was an island country, just like Britain.

text: Itsaspekoak ur azpitik bidaiatzeko eta urpean luzaroan egoteko diseinatutako ontziak dira.
eng_text: Submarines are ships designed to travel underwater, and remain there for an extended amount of time.

text: I. eta II. Mundu Gerran erabili ziren itsaspekoak. Garai hartan, oso mantsoak ziren eta tiro-irismen oso mugatua zuten.
eng_text: Submarines were used in World War I and World War II. Back then they were very slow and had a very limited shooting range.

text: Gerraren hasieran itsaso gainean bidaiatzen zuten batez ere, baina radarra garatzen eta zehatzagoa bihurtzen joan zen heinean, itsaspekoak urpera sartzera behartu zituzten, arerioek ikus ez zitzaten.
eng_text: In the beginning of the war they mostly travelled on top of the sea, but as radar began developing and becoming more accurate the submarines were forced to go under water to avoid being seen.

text: Alemaniako itsaspekoen izena U-Boot zen. Alemaniarrak oso onak ziren beren itsaspekoak gidatzen eta erabiltzen.
eng_text: German submarines were called U-Boats. The Germans were very good at navigating and operating their submarines.

text: Itsaspekoekin zuten arrakasta dela-eta, gerraren ostean alemanei ez zitzaien utzi halako askorik izaten.
eng_text: Because of their success with submarines, after the war Germans aren't trusted to have many of them.

text: Bai! Tutankamon erregea, batzuetan “Tut erregea” edo “mutiko erregea” izenez ezagutzen dena, garai modernoetan gehien ezagutzen den antzinako Egiptoko erregea da.
eng_text: Yes! King Tutankhamun, sometimes referred to as "King Tut" or "The Boy King", is one of the most well known ancient Egyptian kings in modern times.

text: Interesgarria da jakitea antzinako garaietan ez zela garrantzitsutzat jotzen eta ez zegoela erregistratuta antzinako erregeen zerrenda gehienetan.
eng_text: Interestingly, he was not considered to be very important in ancient times and was not recorded on most ancient king lists.

text: Hala ere, 1922an haren hilobia aurkitzeak famatu egin zuen. Iraganeko hilobi asko lapurtu egin zituzten arren, hilobi hau ukitu gabe utzi zen.
eng_text: However, the discovery of his tomb in 1922 made him a celebrity. While many tombs of the past were robbed, this tomb was left virtually undisturbed.

text: Tutankamon-ekin batera hilobiratutako elementu gehienak ere ondo kontserbatu ziren, metal preziatuz eta harri bakanez egindako milaka artefaktu barne.
eng_text: Most of the items buried with Tutankhamun have been well preserved, including thousands of artefacts made from precious metals and rare stones.

text: Erradiodun gurpilak asmatzeari esker, asiriarren gurdiak arinagoak, azkarragoak eta soldaduak eta bestelako gurdiak gainditzeko hobeto prestatuak ziren.
eng_text: The invention of spoke wheels made Assyrian chariots lighter, faster, and better prepared to outrun soldiers and other chariots.

text: Haien arku hilgarriekin jaurtitako geziek kontrako soldaduen armadura zeharkatzen zuten. K.A. 1000. urtean, asiriarrek lehen zalditeria erabili zuten.
eng_text: Arrows from their deadly crossbows could penetrate the armor of rival soldiers. About 1000 B.C., the Assyrians introduced the first cavalry.

text: Zaldien gainean borrokatzen duen armada bat da zalditeria. Zela asmatu gabe zegoen oraindik, eta, beraz, asiriarrek zaldien bizkarren gainean eserita borrokatzen zuten.
eng_text: A cavalry is an army that fights on horseback. The saddle had not yet been invented, so the Assyrian cavalry fought on the bare backs of their horses.

text: Greziako politikari, zientzialari eta artista ugari ezagutzen ditugu. Ziurrenez, kultura horretako pertsonarik ezagunena Homero da, legendazko poeta itsua, greziar literaturako bi maisulan osatu zituena: Iliada eta Odisea poemak.
eng_text: We know many Greek politicians, scientists, and artists. Possibly the most known person of this culture is Homer, the legendary blind poet, who composed two masterpieces of Greek literature: the poems Iliad and Odyssey.

text: Sofokles eta Aristofanes ere antzerkigile famatuak dira oraindik ere, eta haien antzerkiak literaturaren munduko lan handienen artean daude.
eng_text: Sophocles and Aristophanes are still popular playwrights and their plays are considered to be among the greatest works of world literature.

text: Greziako beste pertsona famatu bat Pitagoras matematikaria da. Triangeluen alboen arteko harremanari buruzko teorema famatuagatik da ezaguna, batez ere.
eng_text: Another famous Greek is a mathematician Pythagoras, mostly known for his famous theorem about relations of the sides of right triangles.

text: Hindia hitz egiten duen pertsona kopuruaren hainbat zenbatespen daude. Munduan gehien hitz egiten den hizkuntzetan bigarren eta laugarren postuen artean dago.
eng_text: There are varying estimates for how many people speak Hindi. It is estimated to be between the second and fourth most commonly spoken language in the world.

text: Hizlari natiboen kopurua aldatu egiten da, harekin estu erlazionatuta dauden dialektoak kontuan hartzen diren arabera.
eng_text: The number of native speakers varies depending on whether or not very closely related dialects are counted.

text: Zenbatetsi da 340 eta 500 milioi hizlari artean dituela, eta 800 milioi pertsonak ulertzen dutela hizkuntza.
eng_text: Estimates range from 340 million to 500 million speakers, and as many as 800 million people can understand the language.

text: Hindiak eta urduak hiztegi antzekoa dute baina idazkera ezberdina; eguneroko hizketaldietan, bi hizkuntzen hiztunek bata bestea uler dezakete.
eng_text: Hindi and Urdu are similar in vocabulary but different in script; in everyday conversations, speakers of both languages can usually understand each other.

text: 15. mendearen inguruan, Estoniak Alemaniaren eragin kultural handia zuen.
eng_text: Around the 15th century, northern Estonia was under great cultural influence of Germany.

text: Alemaniako monje batzuek Jainkoa bertakoengana hurbiltzea nahi zuten, eta, horretarako, Estoniako hizkuntza literala asmatu zuten.
eng_text: Some German monks wanted to bring God closer to the native people, so they invented the Estonian literal language.

text: Alfabeto alemanean oinarrituta zegoen, eta "Õ/õ" karakterea gehitu zioten.
eng_text: It was based on the German alphabet and one character "Õ/õ" was added.

text: Denborak aurrera egin ahala, alemanetik hartutako hainbat hitz batu egin ziren. Hori izan zen ilustrazioaren hasiera.
eng_text: As time passed, many words that were borrowed from German coalesced. This was the beginning of enlightenment.

text: Ohikoa zen tronurako oinordekoa armadara joatea eskola bukatu eta berehala.
eng_text: Traditionally, the heir to the throne would go straight into the military after finishing school.

text: Alabaina, Charles unibertsitatera joan zen, Trinity College-ra (Cambridge), eta, han, antropologia eta arkeologia ikasi zituen, eta, beranduago historia; 2.2 nota jaso zuen (bigarren mailako titulu bat).
eng_text: However, Charles went to university at Trinity College, Cambridge where he studied Anthropology and Archaeology, and later History, earning a 2:2 (a lower second class degree).

text: Britainiako Errege Familian titulu bat lortu duen lehen kidea izan zen Charles.
eng_text: Charles was the first member of the British Royal Family to be awarded a degree.

text: Europako Turkiak (Trazia ekialdea edo Rumelia, Balkanetako penintsulan) herrialdearen %3 hartzen du barnean.
eng_text: European Turkey (eastern Thrace or Rumelia in the Balkan peninsula) includes 3% of the country.

text: Turkiako lurraldea 1.600 kilometro (1.000 mi) luze eta 800 km (500 mi) zabal da, eta laukizuzenaren antzeko forma du.
eng_text: The territory of Turkey is more than 1,600 kilometres (1,000 mi) long and 800 km (500 mi) wide, with a roughly rectangular shape.

text: Turkiaren azalerak, lakuak barne, 783.562 kilometro karratu (300.948 mi karratu) betetzen ditu, eta horietatik 755.688 kilometro karratu (291.773 mi karratu) Asia hego-mendebaldean daude eta 23.764 kilometro karratu (9.174 mi karratu) Europan.
eng_text: Turkey's area, including lakes, occupies 783,562 square kilometres (300,948 sq mi), of which 755,688 square kilometres (291,773 sq mi) are in south west Asia and 23,764 square kilometres (9,174 sq mi) in Europe.

text: Turkiaren azalera dela eta, munduko 37. herrialderik handiena da, eta haren tamaina Frantzia eta Britainia Handi metropolitarra konbinatuta duten tamainaren berdina da.
eng_text: Turkey's area makes it the world's 37th-largest country, and is about the size of Metropolitan France and the United Kingdom combined.

text: Turkia itsasoz inguratuta dago hiru aldetan: Egeo itsasoa mendebaldean, Itsaso Beltza iparraldean eta Mediterraneo itsasoa hegoaldean.
eng_text: Turkey is encircled by seas on three sides: the Aegean Sea to the west, the Black Sea to the north and the Mediterranean Sea to the south.

text: Luxenburgok historia luzea du, baina independentzia 1839an lortu zuen.
eng_text: Luxembourg has a long history but its independence dates from 1839.

text: Gaur egungo Belgikako zati batzuk Luxenburgoren zati izan ziren iraganean, baina, 1830eko hamarkadako Belgikako iraultzaren ondoren, Belgikarenak izan ziren.
eng_text: Present-day parts of Belgium were part of Luxembourg in the past but became Belgian after the 1830s Belgian Revolution.

text: Luxenburgo beti saiatu da herrialde neutroa izaten, baina I. eta II. Mundu Gerretan Alemaniak okupatu zuen.
eng_text: Luxembourg has always tried to remain a neutral country but it was occupied in both World War I and World War II by Germany.

text: 1957an, Luxenburgo erakunde baten kide sortzailea izan zen, gaur egun Europako Batasuna izenarekin ezagutzen den erakundearena, hain zuzen.
eng_text: In 1957 Luxembourg became a founding member of the organization which is today known as the European Union.

text: Drukgyal Dzong hondatutako gotorleku eta monasterio budista bat da eta Paro distrituko goiko aldean dago (Phondey herrian).
eng_text: The Drukgyal Dzong is a ruined fortress and Buddhist monastery in the upper part of the Paro District (in Phondey Village).

text: Esaten denez, 1649an, Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyel-ek gotorlekua sortu zuen Tibet eta Mongoliako armaden kontra lortutako garaipena gogoratzeko.
eng_text: It is said that in 1649, Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyel created the fortress to commemorate his victory against the Tibetan-Mongol forces.

text: 1951n, sute baten eraginez Drukgyal Dzong-eko erlikia gutxi batzuk kontserbatu ziren, horien artean, Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyal-en irudia.
eng_text: In 1951, a fire caused for only some of the relics of the Drukgyal Dzong to remain, such as the image of Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyal.

text: Sutearen ondoren, gotorlekua gorde eta zaindu egin zuten, eta Bhutan-go atrakzio paregabeenetako bat da orain ere.
eng_text: After the fire, the fortress was preserved and protected, remaining to be one of Bhutan's most sensational attractions.

text: 18. mendean, Kanbodiak bi bizilagun boteretsuren artean aurkitu zuen bere burua: Thailandia-k eta Vietnam-ek inguratzen zuten.
eng_text: During the 18th century Cambodia found itself squeezed between two powerful neighbors, Thailand and Vietnam.

text: Thai-ek Kanbodia hainbat aldiz inbaditu zuten 18. mendean, eta 1772an Phnom Phen suntsitu zuten.
eng_text: The Thais invaded Cambodia several times in the 18th century and in 1772 they destroyed Phnom Phen.

text: 18. mendeko azken urteetan, vietnamdarrek ere inbaditu zuten Kanbodia.
eng_text: In the last years of the 18th century the Vietnamese also invaded Cambodia.

text: Venezuelako biztanleen ehuneko hemezortzi lanik gabe dago, eta lana duten gehienek ekonomia informalean lan egiten dute.
eng_text: Eighteen percent of Venezuelans are unemployed, and most of those who are employed work in the informal economy.

text: Lan egiten duten venezuelarren bi herenek zerbitzuen sektorean lan egiten dute, ia laurden batek industrian eta bosten batek nekazaritzan.
eng_text: Two thirds of Venezuelans who work do so in the service sector, nearly a quarter work in industry and a fifth work in agriculture.

text: Venezuelarren industria garrantzitsu bat petrolioa da. Herrialdea esportatzaile garbia da, nahiz eta biztanleen ehuneko batak soilik lan egiten duen petrolioaren industrian.
eng_text: An important industry for Venezuelans is oil, where the country is a net exporter, even though only one percent work in the oil industry.

text: Nazioaren independentziaren hasieran, Singapurreko lorategi botanikoko adituek uhartea lorategi-hiri tropikal bihurtzen lagundu zuten.
eng_text: Early in the nation's independence, Singapore Botanic Gardens' expertise helped to transform the island into a tropical Garden City.

text: 1981ean, Vanda Miss Joaquim orkidea hibrido bat hautatu zen herrialdearen lore nazional gisa.
eng_text: In 1981, Vanda Miss Joaquim, an orchid hybrid, was chosen as the nation's national flower.

text: Urtero urria inguruan, 1,5 milioi belarjale iparraldeko mendietatik hegoaldeko lautadetara lekualdatzen dira, Mara ibaia zeharkatuta, euriari jarraituz.
eng_text: Every year around October nearly 1.5 million herbivores travel towards the southern plains, crossing the Mara River, from the northern hills for the rains.

text: Ondoren, iparraldera itzultzen dira mendebaldetik, berriro Mara ibaia zeharkatuz, euriak amaitu ondoren, apirila inguruan.
eng_text: And then back to the north through the west, once again crossing the Mara river, after the rains in around April.

text: Serengeti eskualdeak Serengeti Parke Nazionala, Ngorongoro Kontserbazio Eremua eta Maswa Ehiza Erreserba ditu Tanzanian, eta Maasai Mara Erreserba Nazionala Kenyan.
eng_text: The Serengeti region contains the Serengeti National Park, the Ngorongoro Conservation Area and Maswa Game Reserve in Tanzania and the Maasai Mara National Reserve in Kenya.

text: Multimedia-eduki interaktiboak sortzen ikasteko, trebetasun konbentzionalak eta tradizionalak izan behar dira klase interaktiboetan ikasitako tresnak izateaz gain (gidoi grafikoa egitea, audioa eta bideoa editatzea, narrazioa eta abar)
eng_text: Learning to create interactive media requires conventional and traditional skills, as well as tools mastered in interactive classes (storyboarding, audio and video editing, story telling, etc.)

text: Diseinu interaktiboak multimedia-edukien ekoizpenari buruz dituzun onarpenak berriro ebaluatzera eta modu ez-linealean pentsatzen ikastera behartuko zaitu.
eng_text: Interactive design requires that you re-assess your assumptions about media production and learn to think in a non-linear ways.

text: Diseinu interaktiboa egiteko proiektu bateko osagaiak bata bestearekin konektatu behar dira, baina bakoitzak bere aldetik ere zentzua izan behar du.
eng_text: Interactive design requires that components of a project connect to each other, but also make sense as a separate entity.

text: Zoom lenteen desabantaila da foku-distantzia sorta lortzeko foku-konplexutasun eta lente-elementu askoz gehiago behar direla lente primarioekin baino.
eng_text: The disadvantage of zoom lenses is that the focal complexity and number of lens elements required to achieve a range of focal lengths is much greater than for prime lenses.

text: Arazo hori txikiagotzen ari da, lente-ekoizleak lenteen ekoizpenean estandar hobeak lortzen ari baitira.
eng_text: This is becoming less of an issue as lens manufacturers achieve higher standards in lens production.

text: Horri esker, foku-distantzia finkoa duten lenteekin lortzen den kalitatearen pareko irudiak sortzeko aukera dago zoom lenteekin.
eng_text: This has allowed zoom lenses to produce pictures of a quality comparable to that achieved by lenses with fixed focal length.

text: Zoom lenteen beste desabantaila bat da lentearen irekidura maximoa (abiadura) baxuagoa izan ohi dela.
eng_text: Another disadvantage of zoom lenses is that the maximum aperture (the speed) of the lens is usually lower.

text: Horren ondorioz, zoom lente merkeak erabiltzeko zailagoak dira argi gutxiko kondiziotan flashik ez dagoenean.
eng_text: This makes inexpensive zoom lenses hard to use in low-light conditions without a flash.

text: Film bat DVD formatura bihurtzeko orduan, arazo ohikoenetako bat izaten da overscan.
eng_text: One of the most common problems when trying to convert a movie to DVD format is the overscan.

text: Telebista gehienak publiko orokorraren gustuen arabera egiten dira.
eng_text: Most televisions are made in a way to please the general public.

text: Horregatik, ertzak ebaki zaizkio telebistan ikusten duzun guztiari (goian, behean, zein alboetan).
eng_text: For that reason, everything you see on the TV had the borders cut, top, bottom and sides.

text: Helburua da irudiak pantaila osoa betetzea; horri overscan esaten zaio.
eng_text: This is made to ensure that the image covers the whole screen. That is called overscan.

text: Zoritxarrez, DVD bat egitean, ertzak ere ebakiko dira ziur asko; eta, bideoak azpitituluak behealdetik hurbilegi baditu, ez dira osorik ikusiko.
eng_text: Unfortunately, when you make a DVD, it's borders will most likely be cut too, and if the video had subtitles too close to the bottom, they won't be fully shown.

text: Erdi Aroko gaztelu tradizionalak luzaroan elikatu du irudimena, eta justak, oturuntzak zein Arturoren pareko kemena ekartzen ditu gogora.
eng_text: The traditional medieval castle has long inspired the imagination, conjuring up images of jousts, banquets and Arthurian chivalry.

text: Mila urteko hondakinen artean zutik egonda ere, erraz ekar daitezke gogora aspaldiko borroken soinu eta usainak; ia entzun ere egin daiteke apatxek galtzada-harrietan egiten zuten zarata, eta usaindu lur azpiko ziegatatik igotzen zen beldurra.
eng_text: Even standing amidst thousand year-old ruins it is easy to bring to mind the sounds and smells of battles long gone, to almost hear the clatter of hooves on the cobbles and to smell the fear rising from the dungeon pits.

text: Baina gure irudimena errealitatean oinarrituta al dago? Hasteko, zergatik eraiki ziren gazteluak? Nola diseinatu eta eraiki ziren?
eng_text: But is our imagination based on reality? Why were castles built in the first place? How were they designed and built?

text: Garai hartan ohikoa zen bezala, Kirby Muxloe gaztelua etxe gotortu bat da gaztelu bat baino gehiago.
eng_text: Typical for the period, Kirby Muxloe Castle is more of a fortified house than a true castle.

text: Dituen beiradun leiho handiekin eta horma meheekin, ez lioke luzaroan aurre egingo eraso iraunkor bati.
eng_text: Its large glazed windows and thin walls would not have been able to resist a determined attack for long.

text: 1480ko hamarkadan, Lord Hastings hura eraikitzen hasi zenean, herrialdeak nahiko egoera baketsua zuen eta handik hona ibilian zebiltzan talde txikien kontrako defentsa besterik ez zen behar.
eng_text: In the 1480s, when its construction was begun by Lord Hastings, the country was relatively peaceful and defense was only required against small bands of roving marauders.

text: Botere-orekaren sistemaren bidez, Europako nazioek Europako estatu guztien subiranotasun nazionala mantentzeko helburua zuten.
eng_text: The balance of power was a system in which European nations sought to maintain the national sovereignty of all European states.

text: Kontzeptuaren arabera, Europako nazio guztien lana zen nazio bat bestea baino boteretsuago ez bihurtzea, eta, beraz, gobernu nazionalek aliantzak maiz aldatzen zituzten oreka horri eusteko.
eng_text: The concept was that all European nations had to seek to prevent one nation from becoming powerful, and thus national governments often changed their alliances in order to maintain the balance.

text: Espainiako Ondorengotza Gerra izan zen botere-oreka hori gatazkaren arrazoi nagusi izan zuen lehen gerra.
eng_text: The War of Spanish Succession marked the first war whose central issue was the balance of power.

text: Horrek aldaketa garrantzitsua ekarri zuen, ordutik aurrera Europako nazio boteretsuek ez baitzuten erlijio-gerraren aitzakiarik behar izan. Horrenbestez, Hogeita Hamar Urteko Gerra izan zen erlijio-gerra gisa izendatu zen azkena.
eng_text: This marked an important change, as European powers would no longer have the pretext of being religious wars. Thus, the Thirty Years' War would be the last war to be labeled a religious war.

text: Efeso-n zegoen Artemis-en tenplua O.A.A. 356ko uztailaren 21ean suntsitu zen Herostratus-ek su emanda.
eng_text: The temple of Artemis at Ephesus was destroyed on July 21, 356 BCE in an act of arson committed by Herostratus.

text: Historiak dioenaren arabera, kosta ahala kosta famatu izatea zen haren helburua. Efesoarrek, haserre, iragarri zuten Herostratus-en izena ez zela inoiz erregistratuko.
eng_text: According to the story, his motivation was fame at any cost. The Ephesians, outraged, announced that Herostratus' name never be recorded.

text: Estrabon historialari greziarrak jaso zuen izena, eta hala ezagutzen dugu orain. Alexandro Handia jaio zen gau berean suntsitu zen tenplua.
eng_text: The Greek historian Strabo later noted the name, which is how we know today. The temple was destroyed on the same night that Alexander the Great was born.

text: Alexandro-k, errege zela, tenplua berreraikitzeko beharrezko dirua ordaintzea eskaini zuen, baina atzera bota zuten eskaintza. Beranduago, Alexandro hil ondoren berreraiki zen tenplua O.A.A. 323an.
eng_text: Alexander, as king, offered to pay to rebuild the temple, but his offer was denied. Later, after Alexander died, the temple was rebuilt in 323 BCE.

text: Ziurtatu zure eskua ahalik eta lasaien dagoela nota guztiak zuzen jotzen dituzun bitartean; halaber, saiatu hatzekin beharrezkoak ez diren mugimendurik ez egiten.
eng_text: Make sure your hand is as relaxed as possible while still hitting all the notes correctly - also try not to make much extraneous motion with your fingers.

text: Hala, ahalik eta gutxien nekatuko zara. Gogoan izan ez dagoela teklak indar handiz sakatu beharrik bolumen gehigarria lortzeko, pianoarekin gertatzen denez.
eng_text: This way, you will tire yourself out as little as possible. Remember there's no need to hit the keys with a lot of force for extra volume like on the piano.

text: Akordeoiaren kasuan, bolumen gehigarria lortzeko, hauspoak presio edo abiadura handiagoarekin erabili behar dituzu.
eng_text: On the accordion, to get extra volume, you use the bellows with more pressure or speed.

text: Mistizismoaren helburua da errealitate, dibinitate, egia espiritual edo jainkoaren kontzientzia kontzientea izatea edo harekin bat egitea edo identifikatzea.
eng_text: Mysticism is the pursuit of communion with, identity with, or conscious awareness of an ultimate reality, divinity, spiritual truth, or God.

text: Errealitate jainkotiarrarekin/jainkoarekin edo jainkoekin esperientzia, intuizio edo pertzepzio zuzena izan nahi du sinestunak.
eng_text: The believer seeks a direct experience, intuition, or insight into divine reality/the deity or dieties.

text: Jarraitzaileek esperientzia horiek elikatzeko balio duten bizimodu edo jarduera jakinak egiten dituzte.
eng_text: Followers pursue certain ways of living, or practices that are intended to nurture those experiences.

text: Mistizismoa beste erlijio-sinesmen eta gurtza-formetatik bereizten da, kontzientzia-egoera bereziaren esperientzia pertsonal zuzenean jartzen duelako garrantzia, batez ere, esperientzia baketsu, sakon, zoriontsu eta euforikoetan.
eng_text: Mysticism can be distinguished from other forms of religious belief and worship by its emphasis on the direct personal experience of a unique state of consciousness, particularly those of a peaceful, insightful, blissful, or even ecstatic character.

text: Sikhismoa Indiako azpikontinenteko erlijioa da. Punjab eskualdean sortu zen 15. mendean, Hindu tradizioaren barruan gertatu zen banaketa sektario baten ondorioz.
eng_text: Sikhism is a religion from the Indian sub-continent. It originated in the Punjab region during the 15th century from a sectarian split within the Hindu tradition.

text: Sikh-ek haien erlijioa hinduismotik bereizitzat hartzen dute, nahiz eta haren sustrai eta tradizio hinduak onartzen dituzten.
eng_text: Sikhs consider their faith to be a separate religion from Hinduism though they acknowledge its Hindu roots and traditions.

text: Sikh-ek haren erlijioari Gurmat deritze; punjabieraz “guruaren bidea” esan nahi du. Gurua Indiako erlijio guztien oinarrizko alderdi bat da, baina sikhismoan garrantzia handia du eta sikh sinesmenen muina osatzen du.
eng_text: Sikhs call their religion Gurmat, which is Punjabi for "way of the guru". The guru is a fundamental aspect of all Indian religions but in Sikhism has taken on an importance that forms the core of Sikh beliefs.

text: Erlijioa 15. mendean sortu zuen Guru Nanak-ek (1469-1539). Haren ondoren beste bederatzi guru egon ziren.
eng_text: The religion was founded in the 15th century by Guru Nanak (1469–1539). There followed in succession a further nine gurus.

text: Hala ere, 1956ko ekainean, Krushev-ek egindako promesak probatu egin ziren; Polonian elikagai-gabeziaren eta soldaten jaitsieraren kontrako langileen protesta komunismoaren aurkako protesta orokor bihurtu ziren.
eng_text: However, in June 1956, Krushchev's promises were put to the test when riots in Poland, where workers were protesting against food shortages and wage cuts, turned into a general protest against Communism.

text: Azkenean, Krushev-ek bakea berreskuratzeko tankeak bidali behar izan bazituen ere, eskaera ekonomiko batzuk onartu eta Wladyslaw Gomulka popularra jarri zuen lehen ministro berri gisa.
eng_text: Although in the end, Krushchev sent in tanks to restore order, he did give way to some economic demands and agreed to appoint the popular Wladyslaw Gomulka as the new prime minister.

text: Indus haraneko zibilizazioa Brontze aroko zibilizazio bat zen, Indiako azpikontinenteko ipar-mendebaldean zegoen, eta egungo Pakistanen zati handiena, Indiako ipar-mendebaldeko eskualde batzuk eta Afganistango ipar-ekialdea hartzen zituen.
eng_text: The Indus Valley Civilization was a Bronze Age civilisation in the northwest Indian subcontinent encompassing most of modern-day Pakistan and some regions in northwest India and northeast Afghanistan.

text: Zibilizazioa Indus ibaiaren arroetan garatu zen, eta hortik eratortzen da haren izena.
eng_text: The civilisation flourished in the basins of the Indus River wherefore it derives its name.

text: Aditu batzuen esanean, gaur egun lehortuta dagoen Sarasvati ibaiaren arroetan ere egon zen zibilizazio hori eta, hori dela eta, Indus-Sarasvati zibilizazioa izendatu beharko litzateke. Beste batzuek Harappa-ko zibilizazioa deitzen diote, 1920ko hamarkadan induskatutako lehen gunea izan baitzen Harappa.
eng_text: Although some scholars speculate that since the civilisation also existed in the basins of the now dried up Sarasvati River, it should be aptly called the Indus-Sarasvati Civilization, while some call it the Harappan Civilization after Harappa, the first of its sites to be excavated in the 1920s.

text: Erromatar inperioaren izaera militarrari esker, aurrerapen mediko asko egon ziren.
eng_text: The militaristic nature of the Roman empire aided in the development of medical advances.

text: Augusto enperadoreak doktoreak errekrutatu zituen; are gehiago, erromatarren lehen gorputz medikoa eratu zuen borroken ondoren erabiltzeko.
eng_text: Doctors began to be recruited by Emperor Augustus and even formed the first Roman Medical Corps for use in the aftermath of battles.

text: Kirurgialariek hainbat lasaigarri ezagutzen zituzten, besteak beste, mitxoleta hazien erauzkinetatik lortutako morfina eta erabelarraren hazietatik lortutako eskopolamina.
eng_text: Surgeons had knowledge of various sedatives including morphine from extracts of poppy seeds and scopolamine from herbane seeds.

text: Pazienteak gangrena izatetik salbatzeko anputazioak egiten iaioak bihurtu ziren, baita odol-jarioa eteteko torniketeak eta arterietarako bridak erabiltzen ere.
eng_text: They became proficient at amputation to save patients from gangrene as well as tourniquets and arterial clamps to stem blood flow.

text: Hainbat mendetan, Erromatar inperioak aurrerakuntza handiak egin zituen medikuntzan eta gaur dugun jakintzaren gehiengoa osatu zuen.
eng_text: Over multiple centuries, the Roman empire led to great gains in the field of medicine and formed much of the knowledge we know today.

text: Pureland origamiaren kasuan, bakoitzean toles bakarra egin daiteke, ezin dira atzeranzko tolesak eta bestelako toles konplexuak egin, eta toles guztiek kokapen garbiak izan behar dituzte.
eng_text: Pureland origami is origami with the restriction that only one fold may be done at a time, more complex folds like reverse folds are not allowed, and all folds have straightforward locations.

text: 1970eko hamarkadan garatu zuen John Smith-ek, esperientziarik ez duten tolestaileei edo trebetasun motor mugatuak dituztenei laguntzeko.
eng_text: It was developed by John Smith in the 1970s to help inexperienced folders or those with limited motor skills.

text: Haurrak nahiko gazte direla konturatzen dira arrazez eta arraza-estereotipoez, eta arraza-estereotipo horiek portaeran eragiten dute.
eng_text: Children develop an awareness of race and racial stereotypes quite young and these racial stereotypes affect behavior.

text: Adibidez, eskolan lan gutxi egiten duten estereotipoa duen gutxiengo arraza batekin identifikatzen diren haurrek eskolan emaitza okerragoak izateko joera izaten dute haien arrazarekin erlazionatutako estereotipoaren berri izaten dutenean.
eng_text: For instance, children who identify with a racial minority that is stereotyped as not doing well in school tend to not do well in school once they learn about the stereotype associated with their race.

text: Estatu Batuetan, webgune ezagunenen artean hirugarrena da MySpace, eta 54 milioi profil ditu gaur egun.
eng_text: MySpace is the third most popular website used in the United States and has 54 million profiles currently.

text: Horrelako webguneek arreta handia piztu dute, batez ere hezkuntzaren alorrean.
eng_text: These websites have gotten a lot of attention, especially in the education setting.

text: Horrelako webguneek hainbat abantaila dituzte: esaterako, erraza da eskolan erabiltzeko orrialde bat prestatzea, eta orrialde horretan bildu daitezke blogak, bideoak, argazkiak eta beste hainbat baliabide.
eng_text: There are positive aspects to these websites, which include, being able to easily setup a class page which can include blogs, videos, photos, and other features.

text: Oso erraza da orrialde horretan sartzea, web helbide bat besterik ez baita behar; horrek erraztu egiten du ikasleek gogoratzea, eta, beraz, errazagoa izango da teklatua erabiltzearekin edo ortografiarekin zailtasunak dituzten ikasleentzat ere.
eng_text: This page can easily be accessed by providing just one web address, which makes it easy to remember and easy to type in for students who may have trouble using the keyboard or with spelling.

text: Egokitu egin daiteke, irakurtzeko erraza izan dadin, eta nahi adina kolore jar dakioke, norbere nahiaren arabera.
eng_text: It can be customized to make it easy to read and also with as much or little color as desired.

text: Arreta-defizitaren nahasmendua “sindrome neurologiko bat da, eta definitzen duten sintomen hirukote klasikoa, oldarkortasuna, distraitzeko erraztasuna eta hiperaktibitatea edo gehiegizko energia dira”.
eng_text: Attention Deficit Disorder "is a neurological syndrome whose classic defining triad of symptoms including impulsivity, distractibility, and hyperactivity or excess energy".

text: Ez da ikasketa-desgaitasuna, ikasketa-nahasmendua baizik. “Haurren ehuneko 3-5ek dute, eta, beraz, 2 milioi haur amerikarri eragiten die”.
eng_text: It is not a learning disability, it is a learning disorder; it "affects 3 to 5 percent of all children, perhaps as many as 2 million American children".

text: AFN duten haurrei asko kostatzen zaie eskolako lanetan arreta jartzea, baina erraz kontzentra daitezke gozatzen duten jardueretan, adibidez, jokoak jolasten, marrazki bizidun gogokoak ikusten edo puntuaziorik gabeko esaldiak idazten.
eng_text: Children with ADD have a hard time focusing on things like school work, but they can concentrate on things they enjoy doing like playing games or watching their favorite cartoons or writing sentences without punctuation.

text: Haur horiek arazo ugari izaten dituzte garuna estimulatzeko “jarduera arriskutsuak egiten dituztelako, borroka egiten dutelako eta autoritateari kontra egiten diotelako”, ezin baitute garuna metodo arrunten bidez estimulatu.
eng_text: These children tend to get into a lot of trouble, because they "engage in risky behaviors, get into fights, and challenge authority" in order to stimulate their brain, since their brain can not be stimulated by normal methods.

text: AFNk haurrek parekoekin dituzten harremanei eragiten die, beste haurrek ezin baitute ulertu zergatik jarduten diren modu horretan, edo zergatik idazten dituzten letrak modu horretan edo zergatik den haien heldutasun-maila ezberdina.
eng_text: ADD affects relationships with other peers because other children can not understand why they act the way that they do or why they spell they way they do or that their maturity level is different.

text: Goian aipatu bezala, ezagutza eskuratzeko eta ikasteko gaitasuna aldatu zen modua dela-eta, aldatu egin zen ezagutza jasotzeko oinarrizko erritmoa ere.
eng_text: As the ability to obtain knowledge and to learn changed in such a way as mentioned above the base rate at which knowledge was obtained changed.

text: Informazioa eskuratzeko hurbilketa ezberdina zen. Presioa dagoeneko ez zegoen banako bakoitzak gogoratzeko zuen gaitasunean; horren ordez, testua gogoratzeko gaitasuna bihurtu zen helburu.
eng_text: The approach to obtaining information was different. No longer did pressure reside within individual recall, but the ability to recall text became more of a focus.

text: Oro har, errenazimenduan aldaketa nabarmena gertatu zen ezagutza ikasteko eta hura hedatzeko hurbilketari dagokionez.
eng_text: In essence, the Renaissance made a significant change in the approach to learning and the dissemination of knowledge.

text: Beste primateek ez bezala, hominidoek ez dituzte haien eskuak erabiltzen lokomoziorako, pisuari eusteko edo zuhaitz batetik bestera zintzilik aritzeko.
eng_text: Unlike other primates, hominids no longer use their hands in locomotion or bearing weight or swinging through the trees.

text: Txinpantzearen eskuek eta oinek antzeko tamaina eta luzera dute, eta ezaugarri horrek ukabilekin ibiltzean eskuek pisuari eusteko duten erabilera islatzen du.
eng_text: The chimpanzee's hand and foot are similar in size and length, reflecting the hand's use for bearing weight in knuckle walking.

text: Gizakien eskuak oinak baino laburragoak dira eta falange zuzenagoak dituzte.
eng_text: The human hand is shorter than the foot, with straighter phalanges.

text: Duela bi eta hiru milioi urteko eskuetako hezur fosilizatuek erakusten dute eskuek izan zuten lokomoziotik manipulaziorako espezializazio-aldaketa hori.
eng_text: Fossil hand bones two million to three million years old reveal this shift in specialization of the hand from locomotion to manipulation.

text: Askok uste dute artifizialki induzitutako amets argiak maiz izatea oso neketsua izan daitekeela.
eng_text: Some people believe that experiencing many artificially induced lucid dreams often enough can be very exhausting.

text: Fenomeno horren arrazoi nagusia da amets argiek hedatu egiten dutela REM egoeren arteko denbora-tartea.
eng_text: The main reason for this phenomenon is the result of the lucid dreams expanding the length of time between REM states.

text: REM tartean lo egiten dugu eta orduan du gorputzak berreskuratzeko aukera, eta gaueko halako tarte gutxiago izatea arazo bihur daiteke.
eng_text: With fewer REMs per night, this state in which you experience actual sleep and your body recovers becomes infrequent enough to become a problem.

text: Hogei edo hogeita hamar minuturo esnatu eta telebista ikusten jartzea bezain neketsua da.
eng_text: This is just as exhausting as if you were to wake up every twenty or thirty minutes and watch TV.

text: Zure garunak gaueko amets argiak izateko saiakera kopuruaren mende dago efektua.
eng_text: The effect is dependent on how often your brain attempts to lucidly dream per night.

text: Hasiera-hasieratik okertu zitzaien egoera italiarrei Afrika iparraldean. 1940ko ekainaren 10ean gerra deklaratu eta astebetera, britainiarren XI. husarrak Libiako Capuzzo Gotorlekua bereganatuta zuen.
eng_text: Things did not go well for the Italians in North Africa almost from the start. Within a week of Italy's declaration of war on June 10, 1940, the British 11th Hussars had seized Fort Capuzzo in Libya.

text: Bardiatik ekialdera egindako segada batean, italiarren hamargarren armadako ingeniari burua, Lastucci jenerala, harrapatu zuten britainiarrek.
eng_text: In an ambush east of Bardia, the British captured the Italian Tenth Army's Engineer-in-Chief, General Lastucci.

text: Ekainaren 28an, aldeko bandoak egindako eraso batean hil zuten Italo Balbo mariskala, Libiako Gobernadore nagusia eta Mussoliniren ustezko ondorengoa, Tobruk hirian lur hartzen ari zenean.
eng_text: On June 28, Marshal Italo Balbo, the Governor-General of Libya and apparent heir to Mussolini, was killed by friendly fire while landing in Tobruk.

text: Eskrima kirol modernoa maila askotan jokatzen da: unibertsitatean ikasten ari diren ikasleen mailan nahiz profesionalen eta txapelketa olinpikoen mailan.
eng_text: The modern sport of fencing is played at many levels, from students learning at a university to professional and Olympic competition.

text: Duelu formatuan egiten da oro har, lehiakide bat bestearen kontra.
eng_text: The sport is primarily played in a duel format, one fencer dueling another.

text: Golfean, jokalariek golfeko makilak erabiltzen dituzte pilotak zuloetan sartzeko.
eng_text: Golf is a game in which players use clubs to hit balls into holes.

text: Hemezortzi zulotan jolasten da erronda arrunt batean; normalean, lehenengo zuloan hasten dira jokalariak, eta hemezortzigarrenean bukatu.
eng_text: Eighteen holes are played during a regular round, with players usually starting on the first hole on the course and finishing on the eighteenth.

text: Zirkuitua osatzeko kolpe edo golf-makilarekin swing gutxien egiten dituen jokalariak irabazten du.
eng_text: The player who takes the fewest strokes, or swings of the club, to complete the course wins.

text: Belarrean jolasten da, eta zuloaren inguruko belarra motzago ebakita dago eta green-a deritzo.
eng_text: The game is played on grass, and the grass around the hole is mown shorter and called the green.

text: Baliteke turismo mota ohikoena jende gehienak bidaiatzearekin lotzen duena izatea: aisialdiko turismoa.
eng_text: Perhaps the most common type of tourism is what most people associate with traveling: Recreation tourism.

text: Jendea bere eguneroko bizitzaren oso bestelakoa den toki batera joatean datza, atseden hartzeko eta ongi pasatzeko.
eng_text: This is when people go to a place that is very different from their regular day-to-day life to relax and have fun.

text: Hondartzak, parke tematikoak eta kanpalekuak dira aisialdiko turistek gehien bisitatzen dituzten tokiak.
eng_text: Beaches, theme parks and camp grounds are often the most common places frequented by recreational tourists.

text: Norbait toki jakin batera joaten bada bertako historia eta kultura ezagutzeko helburuarekin, turismo kultural deritzo.
eng_text: If the objective of one’s visit to a particular place is to get to know its history and culture then this type of tourism is known as cultural tourism.

text: Baliteke turistek herrialde jakin bateko leku ezagunak bisitatzea edo arreta zonalde bakarrean jartzea besterik gabe.
eng_text: Tourists may visit different landmarks of a particular country or they may simply opt to focus on just one area.

text: Kolonoek jarduera hori ikusi zutenean, errefortzuak batu zituzten haiek ere.
eng_text: The Colonists, seeing this activity, had also called for reinforcements.

text: Aurreko postuak sendotzen zituzten armadetan New Hampshireko 1. eta 3. erregimentuak zeuden, 200 gizonekin, John Stark eta James Reed koronelen agindupean (biak jeneral izendatu zituzten gero).
eng_text: Troops reinforcing the forward positions included the 1st and 3rd New Hampshire regiments of 200 men, under Colonels John Stark and James Reed (both later became generals).

text: Kolonoen kokapenaren iparraldeko muturrean zegoen hesian kokatu ziren Starken gizonak.
eng_text: Stark's men took positions along the fence on the north end of the Colonist's position.

text: Itsasbeherak Mystic ibaian hutsunea ireki zuenean, penintsularen ipar-ekialdean, hesia azkar luzatu zuten harrizko horma labur batekin, iparraldean bukatzen zena uraren ertzean, hondartza txiki batean.
eng_text: When low tide opened a gap along the Mystic River along the northeast of the peninsula, they quickly extended the fence with a short stone wall to the north ending at the water's edge on a small beach.

text: Gridleyk edo Starkek 100 oineko (30 m) hesola bat jarri zuen hesiaren aurrean eta erregularrek pasa arte tirorik ez egiteko agindua eman zuen.
eng_text: Gridley or Stark placed a stake about 100 feet (30 m) in front of the fence and ordered that no one fire until the regulars passed it.

text: Estatubatuarren planaren oinarria eraso koordinatuak egitean zetzan, hiru norabidetan.
eng_text: The American plan relied on launching coordinated attacks from three different directions.

text: John Cadwalder jeneralak despistatzeko erasoa joko zuen Bordentownen garnizio britainarraren aurka, errefortzuak blokeatzeko helburuarekin.
eng_text: General John Cadwalder would launch a diversionary attack against the British garrison at Bordentown, in order to block off any reinforcements.

text: James Ewing jeneralak 700 milizia hartuko zituen ibaiaren bestaldean, Trenton Ferryn, Assunpik Creek gaineko zubia menderatu eta arerioen armadei ihes egitea eragotzi.
eng_text: General James Ewing would take 700 militia across the river at Trenton Ferry, seize the bridge over the Assunpink Creek and prevent any enemy troops from escaping.

text: 2.400 gizonek osatutako erasorako indar nagusiak Trentonetik bederatzi milia iparralderago gurutzatu zuen ibaia, eta bi taldetan banatu zen, bat Greeneren agindupean eta bestea Sullivanen agindupean, egunsentia baino lehen erasotzeko.
eng_text: The main assault force of 2,400 men would cross the river nine miles north of Trenton, and then split into two groups, one under Greene and one under Sullivan, in order to launch a pre-dawn attack.

text: Milia laurdeneko lasterketatik milia erdira aldatzean, abiadurak askoz garrantzi gutxiagoa dauka eta erresistentzia erabat beharrezkoa da.
eng_text: With the change from the quarter to the half mile run, speed becomes of much less importance and endurance becomes an absolute necessity.

text: Zer esanik ez dago, milia erdiko korrikalari bikain batek, hau da bi minututik beherako denbora egin dezakeen gizon batek, abiadura nahiko behar du, baina erresistentzia landu beharko du nahi eta nahi ez.
eng_text: Of course a first-class half-miler, a man who can beat two minutes, must be possessed of a fair amount of speed, but endurance must be cultivated at all hazards.

text: Neguan kros lasterketa batzuk egitea eta gorputzeko goi-atalak lantzeko gimnasioko ariketak egitea prestaketa onena da lasterketen denboraldirako.
eng_text: Some cross country running during the winter, combined with gymnasium work for the upper part of the body, is the best preparation for the running season.

text: Elikadura ohitura egokiekin soilik ezin da eliteko errendimendua lortu, baina izugarri eragin dezake atleta gazteen osasun orokorrean.
eng_text: Proper nutritional practices alone cannot generate elite performances, but they can significantly affect young athletes' overall wellness.

text: Energiaren oreka osasungarria mantentzeak, hidratazio ohitura eraginkorrak praktikatzeak eta osagarriak hartzearen alderdiak ulertzeak beren errendimendua hobetzen lagundu ahal die atletei, baita kirolaz gehiago gozatzen ere.
eng_text: Maintaining a healthy energy balance, practicing effective hydration habits, and understanding the various aspects of supplementation practices can help athletes improve their performance and increase their enjoyment of the sport.

text: Distantzia ertainean korrika egitea kirol merke samarra da; dena den, parte hartzeko behar den ekipamendu gutxiari buruzko ideia oker asko daude.
eng_text: Middle distance running is a relatively inexpensive sport; however, there are many misconceptions regarding the few pieces of equipment required to participate.

text: Behar ahala eros daitezke produktuak, baina errendimenduan eragin gutxi edo batere ez dute izango gehienek.
eng_text: Products can be purchased as needed, but most will have little or no real impact on performance.

text: Gerta liteke atletek produktu bat nahiago izatea nahiz eta benetako onurarik ez eduki.
eng_text: Athletes may feel that they prefer a product even when it provides no real benefits.

text: Materia oro eraikitzeko funtsezko ataletako bat kontsidera daiteke atomoa.
eng_text: The atom can be considered to be one of the fundamental building blocks of all matter.

text: Oso entitate konplexua da eta, Bohr eredu sinplifikatu baten arabera, elektroiek orbitatzen duten nukleo zentral batez osatuta dago, planetek eguzkia orbitatzen duten bezala, nolabait (ikus 1.1 irudia).
eng_text: Its a very complex entity which consists, according to a simplified Bohr model, of a central nucleus orbited by electrons, somewhat similar to planets orbiting the sun - see Figure 1.1.

text: Nukleoak bi partikula ditu: neutroiak eta protoiak.
eng_text: The nucleus consists of two particles - neutrons and protons.

text: Protoiek karga elektriko positiboa dute eta neutroiek ez dute kargarik. Elektroiek, ordea, karga elektriko negatiboa dute.
eng_text: Protons have a positive electric charge while neutrons have no charge. The electrons have a negative electric charge.

text: Biktima ikuskatzeko, egoera aztertu behar duzu lehenengo, zure segurtasuna bermatzeko.
eng_text: To Check the victim, you must first survey the scene to ensure your safety.

text: Biktimarengana hurbildu ahala, haren jarrera begiratu behar duzu, eta berehalako alarma seinalerik dagoen aztertu.
eng_text: You need to notice the victim's position as you approach him or her and any automatic red flags.

text: Laguntzen saiatzen ari zarenean min hartzen baduzu, egoera okertzeko besterik ez du balioko.
eng_text: If you get hurt trying to help, you may only serve to make matters worse.

text: Ikerketan frogatu egin zen lunbalgia zuten gaixoetan depresioa, beldurra eta pentsaera katastrofista zirela minaren eta ezintasunaren arteko harremanaren bitartekari.
eng_text: The study found that depression, fear and catastrophising mediated the relationship between pain and disability in lower back pain sufferers.

text: Pentsaera katastrofistaren eraginak ziren soilik ariketa fisiko antolatuak astero edukitzearen araberakoak, eta ez depresioa ezta beldurra.
eng_text: Only the effects of catastrophizing, not depression and fear was conditional of regular weekly structured PA sessions.

text: Ariketa erregularki egiten zutenek behar zuten laguntza handiagoa minaren pertzepzio negatiboari zegokionez, min kronikoaren eta mugimendu fisiko arruntak sortutako deserosotasunaren arteko aldea desberdintzeko.
eng_text: Those participating in regular activity required more support in terms of negative perception of pain distinguishing the differences of chronic pain and discomfort feel from normal physical movement.

text: Ikusmenak edo ikusteko gaitasunak ikusmen-sistemaren zentzumen-organoak edo begiak behar ditu.
eng_text: Vision, or the ability to see depends on visual system sensory organs or eyes.

text: Begiek hainbat egitura dituzte, organismoaren beharren arabera konplexutasun-maila bat edo beste dutenak.
eng_text: There are many different constructions of eyes, ranging in complexity depending on the requirements of the organism.

text: Egitura bakoitzak gaitasun bat dauka, uhin-luzera desberdinekiko sentikortasuna dute eta zorroztasun-maila desberdinak dituzte. Halaber, askotariko prozesuak behar dituzte sarrerako informazioari eta hainbat zenbakiri zentzua emateko eta modu onenean funtzionatzeko.
eng_text: The different constructions have different capabilities, are sensitive to different wave-lengths and have differing degrees of acuity, also they require different processing to make sense of the input and different numbers to work optimally.

text: Zonalde geografiko zehatz batean dagoen espezie jakin bateko organismoen bilduma da populazioa.
eng_text: A population is the collection of organisms of a particular species within a given geographic area.

text: Populazio bateko banakoak berdinak direnean ezaugarri fenotipo zehatz bati dagokionez, monomorfiko deritze.
eng_text: When all individuals in a population are identical with regard to a particular phenotypic trait they are known as monomorphic.

text: Banakoek ezaugarri baten hainbat aldaera badituzte, polimorfikoak direla esaten da.
eng_text: When the individuals show several variants of a particular trait they are polymorphic.

text: Inurri soldaduen koloniek fase desberdinak dituzte mugitzeko eta habia egiteko.
eng_text: Army ant colonies march and nest in different phases as well.

text: Nomada fasean, inurri soldaduek gauez desfilatzen dute eta egunez kanpatzen.
eng_text: In the nomadic phase, army ants march at night and stop to camp during the day.

text: Eskura dagoen janaria murrizten denean sartzen da kolonia nomada fasean. Fase horretan, egunero aldatzen diren behin behineko habiak egiten ditu koloniak.
eng_text: The colony begins a nomadic phase when available food has decreased. During this phase, the colony makes temporary nests that are changed everyday.

text: Suntsiketa edo desfile nomada horietako bakoitzak 17 egun irauten du gutxi gorabehera.
eng_text: Each of these nomadic rampages or marches lasts for approximately 17 days.

text: Zer da zelula bat? Zelula hitzak Latineko “cella” hitzean dauka jatorria, “gela txikia” esan nahi duena, eta artelazkiaren egitura aztertzen ari zen mikroskopiolari batek erabili zuen lehen aldiz.
eng_text: What is a cell? The word cell comes from the Latin word "cella", meaning "small room", and it was first coined by a microscopist observing the structure of cork.

text: Zelula da gauza bizidun ororen oinarrizko unitatea, eta organismo guztiak zelula batez edo gehiagoz osatuta daude.
eng_text: The cell is the basic unit of all living things, and all organisms are composed of one or more cells.

text: Bizitzaren ikerketan zelulak hain dira oinarrizkoak eta erabakigarriak, ezen “bizitzaren adreilu” esaten zaie askotan.
eng_text: Cells are so basic and critical to the study of life, in fact, that they are often referred to as "the building blocks of life".

text: Nerbio-sistemak homeostasia mantentzen du nerbio-bulkadak gorputzera bidaliz, odolaren zirkulazioa bermatzeko eta odolaren banaketa homogeneoa izateko.
eng_text: The Nervous System maintains homeostasis by sending nerve impulses through out the body to keep the flow of blood going as well as undisturbed.

text: Nerbio-bulkada horiek oso azkar bidal daitezke gorputzean zehar eta, horri esker, mehatxu posibleetatik babestuta dago gorputza.
eng_text: These nerve impulses can be sent so quickly throughout the body which helps keep the body safe from any potential threat.

text: Tornadoek eremu txiki bat kolpatzen dute beste ekaitz bortitzekin alderatuta, baina den-dena suntsi dezakete haien ibilbidean.
eng_text: Tornadoes strike a small area compared to other violent storms, but they can destroy everything in their path.

text: Zuhaitzak altxatu, eraikinetako oholak erauzi, eta autoak zerura aireratzen dituzte tornadoek. Tornado bortitzenen ehuneko bik hiru ordu baino gehiago irauten dute.
eng_text: Tornadoes uproot trees, rip boards from buildings, and fling cars up into the sky. The most violent two percent of tornadoes last more than three hours.

text: Ekaitz ikaragarri horien haizeek 480 km/h (133 m/s; 300 milia orduko) abiadura izatera iristen dira.
eng_text: These monster storms have winds up to 480 km/h (133 m/s; 300 mph).

text: Milaka urte daramate gizakiak leiar handitzaileak egiten eta erabiltzen.
eng_text: Humans have been making and using lenses for magnification for thousands and thousands of years.

text: Hala ere, benetako lehen teleskopioak Europan egin ziren XVI. mendearen bukaeran.
eng_text: However, the first true telescopes were made in Europe in the late 16th century.

text: Teleskopio horiek bi leiar konbinatzen zituzten urruneko objektuak hurbilago eta handiago ikusteko.
eng_text: These telescopes used a combination of two lenses to make distant objects appear both nearer and larger.

text: Diruzalekeria eta norberekeria gurekin egongo dira beti, eta elkarlanaren funtsa da gehienentzako onura dagoenean beti egongo dela epe laburrean gehiago irabazteko aukera, berekoikeriaz jardunda.
eng_text: Greed and selfishness will always be with us and it is the nature of cooperation that when the majority benefit there will always be more to gain in the short term by acting selfishly

text: Zorte pixka batekin, jende gehiena ohartuko da epe luzerako aukera onena besteekin batera lan egitea dela.
eng_text: Hopefully, most people will realise that their long term best option is to work together with others.
