text: Jende askok amets egiten du gizakiok beste izar batera bidaiatzeko eta beste mundu batzuk esploratzeko unearekin, batzuek jakin nahi dute zer dagoen hor kanpoan, zeren, haien ustez, posible da estralurtarrak edo beste izaki batzuk bizitzea beste planeta batean.
eng_text: Many people dream of the day when humans can travel to another star and explore other worlds, some people wonder what's out there some belive that aliens or other life may live on another plant.

text: Baina, inoiz gertatzen bada, ziurrenik ez da denbora luzean gertatuko. Izarrak hain daude sakabanatuta, ezen bilioika milia daude “auzokideak” diren izarren artean.
eng_text: But, if this ever does happen probably won't happen for a very long time. The stars are so spread out that there are trillions of miles between stars that are "neighbors".

text: Agian, egunen batean, zure birbilobak estralurtarren mundu baten gainean egongo dira haien antzinako arbasoengan pentsatzen?
eng_text: Maybe one day, your great grandchildren will be standing atop an alien world wondering about their ancient ancestors?

text: Animaliak zelula askoz osatuta daude. Gauzak jaten dituzte eta barruan digeritzen. Animalia gehienak mugi daitezke.
eng_text: Animals are made of many cells. They eat things and digest them inside. Most animals can move.

text: Animaliek soilik dute garuna (nahiz eta animalia guztiek ez izan; marmokek, esaterako, ez dute garunik).
eng_text: Only animals have brains (though not even all animals do; jellyfish, for example, do not have brains).

text: Lurraren eremu guztietan daude animaliak. Lurrean zuloak egiten dituzte, itsasoetan igeri, eta zeruan hegan.
eng_text: Animals are found all over the earth. They dig in the ground, swim in the oceans, and fly in the sky.

text: Organismo (gauza) bizi baten egitura- eta funtzio-unitate txikiena da zelula bat.
eng_text: A cell is the smallest structural and functional unit of a living (things) organism.

text: Gela txikia esan nahi duen latineko cella hitzetik dator zelula.
eng_text: Cell comes from the Latin word cella which means small room.

text: Gauza biziak mikroskopioz begiratzen badituzu, lauki edo bola txikiz osatuta daudela ikusiko duzu.
eng_text: If you look at living things under a microscope, you will see that they are made of small squares or balls.

text: Robert Hookek, Ingalaterrako biologo batek, laukitxoak ikusi zituen mikroskopioarekin artelazkian.
eng_text: Robert Hooke, a biologist from England, saw small squares in cork with a microscope.

text: Gela itxura zuten. Zelula hilak ikusi zituen lehenengo pertsona izan zen.
eng_text: They looked like rooms. He was the first person to observe dead cells

text: Elementuak eta konposatuak egoera batetik bestera pasa daitezke aldatu gabe.
eng_text: Elements and compounds can move from one state to another and not change.

text: Nitrogenoak gas moduan nitrogeno likidoaren propietate berberak ditu. Egoera likidoak dentsitate handiagoa dauka, baina molekulak berdinak dira.
eng_text: Nitrogen as a gas still has the same properties as liquid nitrogen. The liquid state is denser but the molecules are still the same.

text: Beste adibide bat ura da. Hidrogenozko bi atomok eta oxigeno atomo batek osatzen dute ur konposatua.
eng_text: Water is another example. The compound water is made up of two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.

text: Egitura molekular berbera dauka, berdin du gasa, likidoa edo solidoa izan.
eng_text: It has the same molecular structure whether it is a gas, liquid, or solid.

text: Egoera fisikoa aldatu arren, egoera kimikoa berdin mantentzen du.
eng_text: Although its physical state may change, its chemical state remains the same.

text: Guztion inguruan dagoen zerbait da denbora, eta egiten dugun guztiari eragiten dio, baina zaila da hura ulertzea.
eng_text: Time is something that is all around us, and affects everything we do, yet is difficult to understand.

text: Milaka urtez, jakintsu erlijioso, filosofiko eta zientifikoek aztertu dute denbora.
eng_text: Time has been studied by religious, philosophical, and scientific scholars for thousands of years.

text: Etorkizunetik orainaldira eta iraganera pasatzen diren gertaeren segida baten moduan bizi dugu denbora.
eng_text: We experience time as a series of events passing from the future through the present to the past.

text: Gertaeren iraupena (luzera) alderatzeko modua ere bada denbora.
eng_text: Time is also how we compare the duration (length) of events.

text: Denboraren iragana zuk zeuk marka dezakezu gertaera ziklikoen errepikapena behatuz. Gertaera ziklikoak erregularki behin eta berriro jazotzen diren zerbait dira.
eng_text: You can mark the passing of time yourself by observing the repetition of a cyclical event. A cyclical event is something that happens again and again regularly.

text: Irudiak eta bideoak manipulatzeko erabiltzen dira ordenagailuak gaur egun.
eng_text: Computers today are used to manipulate pictures and videos.

text: Animazio sofistikatuak eraiki daitezke ordenagailuetan, eta mota horretako animazioa geroz eta gehiago erabiltzen da telebistan eta filmetan.
eng_text: Sophisticated animations can be constructed on computers, and this kind of animation is increasingly being used in television and films.

text: Musika ordenagailu sofistikatuen bidez grabatzen da askotan, soinuak prozesatzeko eta nahasteko.
eng_text: Music is often recorded using sophisticated computers to process and mix sounds together.

text: Denbora luzez, hemeretzigarren eta hogeigarren mendeetan, uste zen Zeelanda Berriko lehen biztanleak Maori herria izan zirela, moa deritzen hegazti erraldoiak ehizatzen zituztenak.
eng_text: For a long time during the nineteenth and twentieth centuries, it was believed the first inhabitants of New Zealand were the Maori people, who hunted giant birds called moas.

text: Teoriaren arabera, Maori jendea Polinesiatik joan zen flota handi batean eta Zeelanda Berria kendu zieten Morioriei, eta nekazal gizartea ezarri zuten.
eng_text: The theory then established the idea that the Maori people migrated from Polynesia in a Great Fleet and took New Zealand from the Moriori, establishing an agricultural society.

text: Hala ere, frogek iradokitzen dute Morioriak Maori kontinentalen talde bat zirela, Zeelanda Berritik Chatham uharteetara migratu, eta beren kultura baketsu adierazgarria garatu zutenak.
eng_text: However, new evidence suggests that the Moriori were a group of mainland Maori who migrated from New Zealand to the Chatham Islands, developing their own distinctive, peaceful culture.

text: Beste tribu bat zegoen Chatham uharteetan, Zeelanda Berritik alde egin zuten Maoriak, alegia.
eng_text: There was also another tribe on the Chatham islands these were Maori who migrated away from New Zealand.

text: Moriori deitzen zieten beren buruei, borroka txiki batzuk egon ziren, eta, azkenean, Morioriak suntsitu zituzten.
eng_text: They called themselves the Moriori there were a few skirmishes and in the end, the Moriori were wiped out

text: Hainbat hamarkada tartean egon diren banakoek lagundu ziguten gure indarrak eta zaletasunak balioesten, zailtasunak eta porrotak ere prestutasunez ebaluatu bitartean.
eng_text: Individuals who had been involved for several decades helped us appreciate our strengths and passions while candidly assessing difficulties and even failures.

text: Bakoitzaren istorio indibidualak, familiarrak eta erakundekoak entzuten, erakundearen kulturan eragin positiboa edo negatiboa zuten nortasun batzuei eta iraganari buruzko informazio interesgarria lortu genuen.
eng_text: While listening to individuals share their individual, family, and organizational stories, we gained valuable insight into the past and some of the personalities who influenced for good or ill the culture of the organization.

text: Baten istorioa ulertzeak halabeharrez kultura ulertzea ez den arren, erakundearen historiaren baitan non kokatzen diren jakiten laguntzen dio gutxienez jendeari.
eng_text: While understanding one’s history does not assume understanding of culture, it does at least help people gain a sense of where they fall within the history of the organization.

text: Arrakastak ebaluatzen eta porroten jakitun izaten, parte hartzaile guztiek modu sakonagoan ezagutzen dituzte erakundearen balioak, misioa eta indar higiarazleak.
eng_text: While assessing the successes and becoming aware of failures, individuals and the whole of the participating persons discover more deeply the values, mission, and driving forces of the organization.

text: Egoera horretan, aurreko jarrera ekintzaileak eta haien arrakasta gogoratzeak jendeari lagundu zion aldaketa berriekiko eta herriko elizarekiko norabide berriarekiko alde agertzen.
eng_text: In this instance, recalling previous instances of entrepreneurial behavior and resulting successes helped people to be open to new changes and new direction for the local church.

text: Arrakasten istorio horiek aldaketekiko beldurra gutxitu zuten, eta etorkizuneko aldaketarekiko joera positiboa sortu.
eng_text: Such success stories lessened the fears of change, while creating positive inclinations toward change in the future.

text: Pentsamendu konbergentearen patroiak arazoak konpontzeko teknikak dira, eta hainbat ideia edo alor elkartzen dituzte irtenbide bat aurkitzeko.
eng_text: Convergent thinking patterns are problem solving techniques that unite different ideas or fields to find a solution.

text: Pentsamolde hori abiaduran, logikan eta zehaztasunean oinarritzen da, baita gertakariak identifikatzean, eskuragarri dauden teknikak erabiltzean eta informazioa biltzean ere.
eng_text: The focus of this mindset is speed, logic and accuracy, also identification of facts, reapplying existing techniques, gathering information.

text: Pentsamolde horren ezaugarri garrantzitsuena honako hau da: erantzun zuzen bakarra dago. Bi erantzun mota posible daude, beraz: zuzena edo okerra.
eng_text: The most important factor of this mindset is: there is only one correct answer. You only think of two answers, namely right or wrong.

text: Mota horretako pentsamenduak lotura estua du hainbat zientzia-prozedura edota prozedura estandarrekin.
eng_text: This type of thinking is associated with certain science or standard procedures.

text: Horrela pentsatzen duten pertsonek pentsamendu logikoa dute eta patroiak memorizatzeko gai dira, baita arazoak konpontzeko eta zientzia-probetan lan egiteko ere.
eng_text: People with this type of thinking have logical thinking, are able to memorize patterns, solve problems and work on scientific tests.

text: Besteen pentsamenduak hoberen irakurtzen dituen espeziea dira gizakiak, gaindika.
eng_text: Humans are by far the most talented species in reading the minds of others.

text: Horrek esan nahi du zuzen asmatzeko gai garela beste gizaki batzuek antzematen, sinesten edo nahi dutena, dakitena edo zer asmo duten.
eng_text: That means we are able to successfully predict what other humans perceive, intend, believe, know or desire.

text: Gaitasun horien artean, beste batzuen asmoak ulertzea funtsezkoa da. Ekintza fisikoen anbiguotasun posibleak ebazteko aukera ematen digu.
eng_text: Among these abilities, understanding the intention of others is crucial. It allows us to resolve possible ambiguities of physical actions.

text: Esate baterako, norbait auto bateko leihoa apurtzen ikusiko bazenu, beste norbaiten autoa lapurtzen saiatzen ari dela pentsatuko zenuke ziurrenik.
eng_text: For example, if you were to see someone breaking a car window, you would probably assume he was trying to steal a stranger’s car.

text: Autoko giltzak galdu, eta bere autoan sartzen saiatzen ari bazen, beste iritzi bat eduki beharko genuke.
eng_text: He would need to be judged differently if he had lost his car keys and it was his own car that he was trying to break into.

text: Erresonantzia magnetiko bidezko irudiak erresonantzia magnetiko nuklear (EMN) deritzon fenomeno fisiko batean oinarrituta daude, zeina Felix Blochek (Stanford Unibertsitatean lanean) eta Edward Purcellek (Harvard Unibertsitatekoa) aurkitu zuten 1930eko hamarkadan.
eng_text: MRI is based on a physics phenomenon called nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR), which was discovered in the 1930s by Felix Bloch (working at Stanford University) and Edward Purcell (from Harvard University).

text: Erresonantzia horretan, eremu magnetikoaren eta irrati-uhinen eraginez, atomoek irrati-seinale txiki-txikiak igortzen dituzte.
eng_text: In this resonance, magnetic field and radio waves cause atoms to give off tiny radio signals.

text: 1970ean, Raymond Damadianek, medikua eta zientzia ikerlaria, erresonantzia magnetiko bidezko irudiak diagnostiko medikoak egiteko tresna gisa erabiltzeko oinarriak aurkitu zituen.
eng_text: In the year 1970, Raymond Damadian, a medical doctor and research scientist, discovered the basis for using magnetic resonance imaging as a tool for medical diagnosis.

text: Lau urte geroago, patente bat eman zen; erresonantzia magnetiko bidezko irudien arloan munduan egin zen lehenengo patentea.
eng_text: Four years later a patent was granted, which was the world's first patent issued in the field of MRI.

text: 1977an, Damadian doktoreak erresonantzia magnetiko bidezko irudien “gorputz osoko” eskanerraren eraketa osatu zuen, eta “Menderakaitza” izena jarri zion.
eng_text: In 1977, Dr. Damadian completed the construction of the first “whole-body” MRI scanner, which he called the ”Indomitable”.

text: Komunikazio asinkronoak hausnarketarako eta erreakzionatzeko denbora sustatzen du besteengan.
eng_text: Asynchronous communication encourages time for reflection and reaction to others.

text: Ikasleei aukera ematen die beren erritmoan lan egiteko eta hezkuntza-informazioaren erritmoa kontrolatzeko.
eng_text: It allows students the ability to work at their own pace and control the pace of instructional information.

text: Horretaz gain, lan egiteko ordu malguen aukerarekin, denbora-muga gutxiago daude (Bremer, 1998).
eng_text: In addition, there are fewer time restrictions with the possibility of flexible working hours. (Bremer, 1998)

text: Internetaren eta mundu zabaleko amaraunaren erabilerak informazioa edonoiz atzitzeko aukera ematen die ikasleei.
eng_text: The use of the Internet and the World Wide Web allows learners to have access to information at all times.

text: Halaber, ikasleek eguneko edozein unetan bidal diezaiekete galderak irakasleei eta nahiko erantzun azkarrak espero, elkar ikusiko duten hurrengo unera arte itxaron beharrean.
eng_text: Students can also submit questions to instructors at any time of day and expect reasonably quick responses, rather than waiting until the next face-to-face meeting.

text: Ikasteari buruzko metodo postmodernoak askatasun absolutua eskaintzen du. Ez dago ikasteko modu egoki bakarrik.
eng_text: The postmodern approach to learning offers the freedom from absolutes. There is no one good way to learn.

text: Izan ere, ez dago ikasteko gauza egoki bakarrik. Ikaslearen eta aurkeztutako ezagutzaren arteko esperientzian gertatzen da jakintza.
eng_text: In fact, there is not one good thing to learn.Learning takes place in the experience between the learner and the knowledge presented.

text: Brikolajearen eta informazioaren aurkezpena bizi ditugu oraintsu, eta hori islatzen dute ikastean oinarritutako telebista-saioek.
eng_text: Our current experience with all the do-it-yourself and information presenting, learning-based television shows illustrates this point.

text: Gutako asko egoten gara telebistako programa bat ikusten, non hor azaltzen diguten prozesu edo esperientzian ez dugun inoiz parte hartuko edo ez dugun inoiz ezagutza hori praktikan jarriko.
eng_text: So many of us find ourselves watching a television show that informs us of a process or experience in which we will never participate or apply that knowledge.

text: Ez dugu auto bat inoiz aztertuko, lorategian iturri bat eraikiko, antzinako hondakinak ikertzeko Perura bidaiatuko edo auzokidearen etxea birmoldatuko.
eng_text: We will never overhaul a car, build a fountain in our backyard, travel to Peru to examine ancient ruins, or remodel our neighbour's house.

text: Europarekin lotzen duen itsaso azpiko zuntz optikoari eta banda zabaleko sateliteari esker, Groenlandia ongi konektatuta dago eta biztanleriaren % 93k dauka Internet konexioa.
eng_text: Thanks to undersea fiber optic cable links to Europe and broadband satellite, Greenland is well connected with 93% of the population having internet access.

text: Segur aski hotelak edo anfitrioiak (apopilo-etxe edo etxe pribatu batean baldin bazaude) wifia edo Internetera konektatutako ordenagailu bat izango du, eta kokaleku guztietan dago ziberkafetegi bat edo wifi publikoa daukan tokiren bat.
eng_text: Your hotel or hosts (if staying in a guesthouse or private home) will likely have wifi or an internet connected PC, and all settlements have an internet cafe or some location with public wifi.

text: Lehen aipatu bezala, “eskimal” hitza AEBetan onartzen den arren, estatubatuarrak ez diren Artikoko herri askok peioratibotzat hartzen dute, Kanadan bereziki.
eng_text: As mentioned above, though the word "Eskimo" remains acceptable in the United States, it is considered pejorative by many non-U.S. Arctic peoples, especially in Canada.

text: Groenlandiar natiboei hitz hori entzuten badiezu ere, komeni da kanpotarrek ez erabiltzea.
eng_text: While you may hear the word used by Greenlandic Natives, its use should be avoided by foreigners.

text: Groenlandiako biztanle natiboek Inuit esaten diete haien buruei Kanadan, eta Kalaalleq (plurala Kalaallit), groenlandiarra esateko, Groenlandian.
eng_text: The native inhabitants of Greenland call themselves Inuit in Canada and Kalaalleq (plural Kalaallit), a Greenlander, in Greenland.

text: Delituak eta kanpotarren aurkako jokaera desegokia ez dira ia ezagutzen Groenlandian. Herrietan ere, ez dago “eremu zailik”.
eng_text: Crime, and ill-will toward foreigners in general, is virtually unknown in Greenland. Even in the towns, there are no "rough areas."

text: Eguraldi hotza da, agian, prestatuta ez datorrenak izango duen arrisku bakarra.
eng_text: Cold weather is perhaps the only real danger the unprepared will face.

text: Groenlandiara etortzen bazara urtaro hotzetan (geroz eta iparralderago joan, geroz eta hotz handiagoa), oinarritzekoa da nahikoa beroa den arropa ekartzea.
eng_text: If you visit Greenland during cold seasons (considering that the further north you go, the colder it will be), it is essential to bring warm enough clothing.

text: Udako egun oso luzeek lo nahikoa ez egitearekin lotutako arazoak eta erlazionatutako osasun arazoak sor ditzakete.
eng_text: The very long days in the summer can lead to problems getting sufficient sleep and associated health issues.

text: Udan, kontuz ibili eltxo nordikoekin. Ez dute gaixotasunik transmititzen, baina narritagarriak izan daitezke.
eng_text: During the summer, also watch out for the Nordic mosquitoes. Although they do not transmit any diseases, they can be irritating.

text: San Frantziskoko ekonomia lotuta egon arren mundu mailan turismoa erakartzen duen tokia izatearekin, ekonomia dibertsifikatuta dago.
eng_text: While San Francisco's economy is linked to it being a world-class tourist attraction, its economy is diversified.

text: Zerbitzu profesionalak, gobernua, finantzak, merkataritza eta turismoa dira lan-sektore nagusiak.
eng_text: The largest employment sectors are professional services, government, finance, trade, and tourism.

text: Musikan, filmetan, literaturan eta herri-kulturan askotan agertu denez, hiria eta haren toki ezagunak famatu bihurtu dira mundu osoan.
eng_text: Its frequent portrayal in music, films, literature and popular culture has helped make the city and its landmarks known throughout the world.

text: San Frantziskok turistentzako azpiegitura handia garatu du, hainbat hotel, jatetxe eta primerako batzarretarako zerbitzuekin.
eng_text: San Francisco has developed a large tourist infrastructure with numerous hotels, restaurants, and top-notch convention facilities.

text: San Frantzisko ere nazioko toki onenetakoa da bestelako sukaldaritza asiarra jateko: korearra, tailandiarra, indiarra eta japoniarra.
eng_text: San Francisco is also one of the best places in the nation for other Asian cuisine: Korean, Thai, Indian, and Japanese.

text: Walt Disney World-era bidaiatzea erromesaldi garrantzitsua da familia amerikar askorentzat.
eng_text: Traveling to Walt Disney World represents a major pilgrimage for many American families.

text: “Ohiko” bisitak barne hartzen du Orlandoko Nazioarteko Aireportura joatea, autobusez Disney parkeko hotel batera joatea, astebete inguru ematea Disney eremutik atera gabe eta etxera bueltatzea.
eng_text: The "typical" visit involves flying into Orlando International Airport, busing to an on-site Disney hotel, spending about a week without leaving Disney property, and returning home.

text: Aldaera amaigabeak daude, baina hori da jende gehienak esan nahi duena “Disney World-era joatea” esaten duenean.
eng_text: There are infinite variations possible, but this remains what most people mean when they talk of "going to Disney World".

text: Interneten eBay edo Craigslist bezalako webguneen bidez saltzen diren txartelak erabat erabili ez diren eta parke batetik bestera joateko hainbat egunetarako txartelak dira.
eng_text: Many tickets sold online through auction websites such as eBay or Craigslist are partially used multi-day park-hopper tickets.

text: Oso jarduera ohikoa izan arren, Disney-k debekatu egiten du: txartelak ezin dira eskualdatu.
eng_text: While this is a very common activity, it is prohibited by Disney: the tickets are non-transferable.

text: Kanpaldi libreak egiteko baimena eduki behar du Arroila Handiaren bazterraren azpitik muntatutako edozein kanpalekuk.
eng_text: Any camping below the rim in Grand Canyon requires a backcountry permit.

text: Arroila babesteko, baimenak mugatuta daude, eta hilaren lehenengo egunean jartzen dira eskuragarri, hasierako hilabetea baino lau hilabete lehenago.
eng_text: Permits are limited to protect the canyon, and become available on the 1st day of the month, four months prior to the start month.

text: Hortaz, maiatzean hasten den edozein zeharbide-baimen urtarrilaren 1ean egongo da eskuragarri.
eng_text: Thus, a backcountry permit for any start date in May becomes available on 1 Jan.

text: Toki ospetsuenak, hala nola Phantom Ranch ondoko Bright Angel kanpalekua, erreserbak egiteko lehen egunean bete ohi dira.
eng_text: Space for the most popular areas, such as the Bright Angel Campground adjacent to Phantom Ranch, generally fill up by the requests received on first date they are opened to reservations.

text: Erreserbarik gabeko eskaeretarako baimen kopuru mugatu bat ere badago, eta iritsiera ordenaren arabera ematen dira.
eng_text: There are a limited number permits reserved for walk-in requests available on a first come, first served basis.

text: Hegoaldeko Afrikara autoz iristea eskualdearen edertasuna ikusteko modu zoragarria da, baita turisten ohiko ibilbideetan ez dauden tokietara joateko ere.
eng_text: Entering Southern Africa by car is an amazing way to see all the region's beauty as well as to get to places off the normal tourist routes.

text: Aurretik ongi antolatuz gero, auto arrunt batekin egin daiteke, baina 4x4 bat da gomendagarriena, eta toki batzuetara bataila altuko 4x4 autoekin soilik irits daiteke.
eng_text: This can be done in a normal car with careful planning but a 4x4 is highly advised and many locations are only accessible with a high wheel base 4x4.

text: Plana egitean, kontuan izan Hegoaldeko Afrika egonkorra den arren, hori ez dela inguruko herrialde guztien kasua.
eng_text: Keep in mind while planning that although Southern Africa is stable not all neighboring countries are.

text: Bisa eskakizunak eta kostuak nazio batetik bestera aldatu egiten dira, eta jatorrizko herrialdeak eragina dauka horietan.
eng_text: Visa requirements and costs vary from nation to nation and are affected by the country you come from.

text: Herrialde bakoitzak, gainera, autoan eraman beharreko larrialdietarako gauzen araudi propioa dauka.
eng_text: Each country also has unique laws requiring what emergency items need to be in the car.

text: Victoria Falls Zimbabweren mendebaldean dagoen herria da, Livingstoneko eta Zambiako mugetan, eta Botswanatik hurbil.
eng_text: Victoria Falls is a town in the western portion of Zimbabwe, across the border from Livingstone, Zambia, and near Botswana.

text: Herria ur-jauzien ondo-ondoan dago, eta horiek dira toki interesgarri nagusiena, baina turistentzat helmuga ezaguna den honek abentura nahi dutenentzako eta leku interesgarriak bisitatu nahi dituztenentzako aukera pila eskaintzen ditu, denbora luzeko egonaldietarako.
eng_text: The town lies immediately next to the falls, and they are the major attraction, but this popular tourist destination offers both adventure seekers and sightseers plenty of opportunities for a longer stay.

text: Urtaro euritsuan (azarotik martxora), uraren emaria handiagoa izango da eta ur-jauziak ikusgarriagoak izango dira.
eng_text: In the rainy season (November to March), the water volume will be higher and the Falls will be more dramatic.

text: Ziur busti egingo zarela zubia pasatzen baduzu edo ur-jauzien ondoan dauden bide bihurgunetsuetan ibiltzen bazara.
eng_text: You are guaranteed to get wet if you cross the bridge or walk along the trails winding near the Falls.

text: Bestetik, hain justu ur emaria oso handia delako, ur-jauzien beren ikuspegia oztopatu egingo dizu ur kantitate handiak!
eng_text: On the other hand, it is precisely because the volume of water is so high that your viewing of the actual Falls will be obscured—by all the water!

text: Tutankamonen hilobia (KV62). Baliteke KV62-a haraneko hilobirik famatuena izatea, Howard Carterrek 1922an errege gaztearen hilobia ia osorik aurkitu zueneko eszena.
eng_text: Tomb of Tutankhamun (KV62). KV62 may be the most famous of the tombs in the Valley, the scene of Howard Carter's 1922 discovery of the almost intact royal burial of the young king.

text: Beste errege-hilobiekin alderatuta, ordea, Tutankamonenak ia ez du bisitarik merezi, askoz txikiagoa delako eta apaingarri gutxi dituelako.
eng_text: Compared to most of the other royal tombs, however, the tomb of Tutankhamun is barely worth visiting, being much smaller and with limited decoration.

text: Momia zerraldotik ateratzen saiatu zirenean egindako kalteen frogak ikusi nahi dituen edonor nahigabetu egingo da, burua eta sorbaldak soilik ikusten zaizkio eta.
eng_text: Anyone interested in seeing evidence of the damage to the mummy done during attempts to remove it from the coffin will be disappointed as only the head and shoulders are visible.

text: Hilobiko ondasun zoragarriak ez daude bertan, Kairoko Egiptoar Museora eraman baitzituzten.
eng_text: The fabulous riches of the tomb are no longer in it, but have been removed to the Egyptian Museum in Cairo.

text: Denbora gutxi duten bisitariek hobe dute denbora beste nonbait pasatu.
eng_text: Visitors with limited time would be best to spend their time elsewhere.

text: Phnom Krom, Siem Reapetik 12 km hego-mendebaldera. Tontorreko tenplu hau IX. mendearen bukaeran eraiki zen, Yasovarman erregearen agintaldian.
eng_text: Phnom Krom, 12 km southwest of Siem Reap. This hilltop temple was built at the end of the 9th century, during the reign of King Yasovarman.

text: Tenpluaren giro ilunarengatik eta Tonle Sap lakuaren bistengatik merezi du mendira igotzea.
eng_text: The gloomy atmosphere of the temple and the view over the Tonle Sap lake make the climb to the hill worthwhile.

text: Toki hau bisitatzea era egokian konbina daiteke lakuan txalupa batean ibiltzearekin.
eng_text: A visit to the site can be conveniently combined with a boat trip to the lake.

text: Tenpluan sartzeko Angkor pasea beharko duzunez, ez ahaztu pasaportea Tonle Sapera joaten zarenean.
eng_text: The Angkor Pass is needed to enter the temple so do not forget to bring your passport along when heading to Tonle Sap.

text: Jerusalem Israelgo hiriburua eta hiririk handiena da, nahiz eta beste herrialde askok eta Nazio Batuen Erakundeak ez duten Israelgo hiriburu gisa onartzen.
eng_text: Jerusalem is the capital and largest city of Israel, though most other countries and the United Nations do not recognize it as Israel's capital.

text: Judeako mendietako hiri zaharrak milaka urtetako historia zirraragarria dauka.
eng_text: The ancient city in the Judean Hills has a fascinating history spanning thousands of years.

text: Hiri sakratua da hiru erlijio monoteistetan (judaismoa, kristautasuna eta islama), eta erdigune espiritual, erlijioso eta kulturalaren funtzioa dauka.
eng_text: The city is holy to the three monotheistic religions - Judaism, Christianity and Islam, and serves as a spiritual, religious, and cultural center.

text: Hiriaren, eta, bereziki, hiri zaharreko toki askoren garrantzi erlijiosoaren ondorioz, Israelgo helmuga turistiko nagusienetakoa da Jerusalem.
eng_text: Due to the religious significance of the city, and in particular the many sites of the Old City area, Jerusalem is one of the main tourist destinations in Israel.

text: Jerusalemek leku historiko, arkeologiko eta kultural asko ditu, baita saltoki-gune, kafetegi eta jatetxe bizi eta jendetsuak ere.
eng_text: Jerusalem has many historic, archeological and cultural sites, along with vibrant and crowded shopping centers, cafés, and restaurants.

text: Nazioarteko aireportuen edo mugetako sarreren bidez Ekuadorrera sartu baino lehen gonbidapen bat jasotzeko eskatzen die Ekuadorrek Kubako biztanleei.
eng_text: Ecuador requires that Cuban citizens receive an invitation letter prior to entering Ecuador through international airports or frontier admission points.

text: Gutuna Ekuadorreko Atzerri Arazoetako Ministerioak egiaztatu behar du, eta baldintza batzuk bete behar ditu.
eng_text: This letter must be legalized by the Ecuadorian Ministry of Foreign Affairs, and comply with certain requirements.

text: Bi herrialdeen arteko migrazio fluxuak antolatzeko diseinatuta daude baldintza horiek.
eng_text: These requirements are designed to provide an organized migratory flow between both countries.

text: AEBetako erresidentzia-baimena duten kubatar biztanleek ekuadortar kontsuletxe batera joan behar dute baldintza horren salbuespena lortzeko.
eng_text: Cuban citizens who are US green card holders should visit an Ecuadorian Consulate to obtain an exemption to this requirement.

text: Pasaporteak baliozkoa izan behar du bidaiaren data eta ondorengo 6 hilabeteetan. Joan-etorriko txartelak behar dira, egonaldiaren iraupena frogatzeko.
eng_text: Your passport must be valid for at least 6 months beyond your travel dates. A round/onward trip ticket is needed to prove the length of your stay.

text: Bakarrik edo lagun batekin soilik bazaude, gogoan izan talde handien bisitaldiak merkeagoak direla; hortaz, saiatu jende gehiago ezagutzen eta bildu lau eta sei pertsona bitarteko talde bat, prezio hobea lortzeko.
eng_text: Tours are cheaper for larger groups, so if you're by yourself or with just one friend, try to meet other people and form a group of four to six for a better per-person rate.

text: Hala ere, ez kezkatu gehiegi horretaz, turistak hara eta hona eramaten baitituzte kotxeak betetzeko.
eng_text: However, this shouldn't really be off your concern, because often tourists are shuffled around to fill the cars.

text: Badirudi jendeak gehiago ordaintzeko trikimailu bat dela, beste ezeren gainetik.
eng_text: It seems actually to be more a way of tricking people into believing they have to pay more.

text: Machu Picchuren iparraldean dago dorre itxurako mendi maldatsu hau, eta hondarren argazkietako atzealde izan ohi da.
eng_text: Towering above the north end of Machu Picchu is this steep mountain, often the backdrop to many photos of the ruins.

text: Behetik ikaragarria dirudi, eta maldatsua eta igotzeko zaila da, baina sasoi onean dagoen edonor da gora igotzeko gai 45 minutu ingurutan.
eng_text: It looks a bit daunting from below, and it is a steep and difficult ascent, but most reasonably fit persons should be able to make it in about 45 minutes.

text: Harriak daude ipinita ia bide guztian zehar, koska gisa, eta maldatsuenak diren tarteetan altzairuzko kableak daude, baranda gisa erabiltzeko.
eng_text: Stone steps are laid along most of the path, and in the steeper sections steel cables provide a supporting handrail.

text: Hori esan ondoren, jakinarazten dizugu hitzik gabe geratuko zarela. Halaber, kontuz ibili tarte maldatsuetan, batez ere hezetasuna badago, arriskutsua izan baitaiteke.
eng_text: That said, expect to be out of breath, and take care in the steeper portions, especially when wet, as it can become dangerous quickly.

text: Pasa beharreko koba txiki bat dago puntatik gertu, nahiko baxua eta estua.
eng_text: There's a tiny cave near the top that must be passed through, it is quite low and a rather tight squeeze.

text: Galapagoetako lekuak eta fauna hobeto ikusten dira itsasontziz, Charles Darwinek 1835ean egin zuen bezala.
eng_text: Seeing the sites and wildlife of the Galapagos is best done by boat, just as Charles Darwin did it in 1835.

text: 60 gurutzaontzi baino gehiagok betetzen dituzte Galapagoetako urak; 8 eta 100 bidaiari bitarte ditu bakoitzak.
eng_text: Over 60 cruise ships ply the Galapagos waters - ranging in size from 8 to 100 passengers.

text: Gehienek aldez aurretik egiten dituzte erreserbak (goi-denboraldian beteta egoten dira eta ontziak).
eng_text: Most people book their place well in advance (as the boats are usually full during the high season).

text: Ziurtatu erreserba egiten laguntzen dizun agentea Galapagos uhartean aditu izatea, eta ontzi desberdinei buruz jakitea.
eng_text: Be sure the agent through whom you book is a Galapagos specialist with a good knowledge of a wide variety of ships.

text: Horri esker, gehien interesatzen edo mugatzen zaituena kontuan hartuko da ontzia hautatzerakoan.
eng_text: This will ensure that your particular interests and/or constraints are matched with the ship most suitable to them.

text: Espainiarrak 16. mendean iritsi aurretik, Txile iparraldea Inken boterepean zegoen eta Araucania-ko biztanle indigenak (Mapucheak) Txile erdialde eta hegoaldean bizi ziren.
eng_text: Before the Spanish arrived in the 16th century, northern Chile was under Inca rule while the indigenous Araucanians (Mapuche) inhabited central and southern Chile.

text: Mapucheak ere izan ziren Amerikako azken talde indigena independenteetako bat. Izan ere, ez zituzten gaztelaniaz hitz egitera behartzen zituen arauak erabat bereganatu Txileren independentziaren ostera arte.
eng_text: The Mapuche were also one of the last independent American indigenous groups, that were not fully absorbed into Spanish-speaking rule until after Chile's independence.

text: Txilek independentzia 1810an adierazi arren (Napoleonen gudek Espainia funtzionatzen zuen gobernu zentralik gabe utzi ondoren urte batzuez), Espainiaren aurkako garaipena ez zen lortu 1818 arte.
eng_text: Although Chile declared independence in 1810 (amid the Napoleonic wars that left Spain without a functioning central government for a couple of years), decisive victory over the Spanish was not achieved until 1818.

text: Dominikar Errepublika (Gaztelaniaz: República Dominicana) Karibeko herrialdea da, Hispaniola uhartearen ekialdeko erdia hartzen duena, eta, beste erdia, Haitik hartzen du.
eng_text: The Dominican Republic (Spanish: República Dominicana) is a Caribbean country that occupies the eastern half of the island of Hispaniola, which it shares with Haiti

text: Harea zuriko hondartzez eta paisaia menditsuez gain, Ameriketako hiri europar zaharrena dago bertan, orain Santo Domingoko parte dena.
eng_text: Besides white sand beaches and mountain landscapes, the country is home to the oldest European city in the Americas, now part of Santo Domingo.

text: Taínoak eta karibetarrak bizi ziren hasieran uhartean. Karibetarrek arawakera mintzatzen zuten, eta K.a. 10.000. urte inguruan iritsi ziren.
eng_text: The island was first inhabited by the Taínos and Caribes. The Caribes were an Arawakan-speaking people who had arrived around 10,000 BCE.

text: Esploratzaile europarrak iritsi eta urte gutxi batzuetara, Taínoko biztanleria izugarri murriztu zuten konkistatzaile espainiarrek.
eng_text: Within a few short years following the arrival of European explorers, the population of Tainos had significantly been reduced by the Spanish conquerors

text: Fray Bartolomé de las Casasen arabera (Indietako Tratatua), 1492 eta 1498 urteen artean 100.000 taíno inguru erail zituzten konkistatzaile espainiarrek.
eng_text: Based on Fray Bartolomé de las Casas (Tratado de las Indias) between 1492 and 1498 the Spanish conquerors killed around 100,000 Taínos.

text: Jardín de la Unión. 17. mendeko komentu bateko ataria zen; guzti hartatik, ordea, San Diego-ko Tenplua soilik geratzen da.
eng_text: Jardín de la Unión. This space was built as the atrium for a 17th-century convent, of which the Templo de San Diego is the sole surviving building.

text: Erdiguneko plaza gisa erabiltzen da orain eta beti dago ospakizunen bat, gau eta egun.
eng_text: It now functions as the central plaza, and always has a lot of things going on, day and night.

text: Hainbat jatetxe daude lorategiaren ondoan eta arratsalde eta iluntzeetan doako kontzertuak egiten ohi dira erdiko kioskoan.
eng_text: There are a number of restaurants surrounding the garden, and in the afternoons and evening there free concerts are often given from the central gazebo.

text: Callejón del Beso (muxuaren kalezuloa). 69 zentimetroz banatutako bi balkoi dira maitasun-mito zahar baten etxe.
eng_text: Callejon del Beso (Alley of the Kiss). Two balconies separated by only 69 centimeters is home of an old love legend.

text: Hainbat umek istorioa kontatuko dizute txanpon batzuen truke.
eng_text: For a few pennies some children will tell you the story.

text: Bowen Island eguneko edo asteburuko txangoak egiteko toki ezaguna da eta kayak-a edo ibilaldiak egiteko aukera ez ezik, dendak, jatetxeak eta aukera gehiago ere eskaintzen ditu.
eng_text: Bowen Island is a popular day trip or weekend excursion offering kayaking, hiking, shops, restaurants, and more.

text: Komunitate jator hau Howe Sound-en dago, Vancouverren kanpoaldean, eta erraz joan daiteke bertara Vancouver erdialdeko Granville Island-etik ateratzen diren uretako taxien bidez.
eng_text: This authentic community is located in Howe Sound just off Vancouver, and is easily accessed via scheduled water taxis departing Granville Island in downtown Vancouver.

text: Kanpoko jarduerak atsegin dituztenentzat, ezinbestekoa da Sea to Sky korridorera joatea.
eng_text: For those who enjoy outdoor activities, a trek up the Sea to Sky corridor is essential.

text: Whistler (Vancouvertik ordu eta erdira) garestia da, baina ezaguna 2010eko neguko olinpiadak direla eta.
eng_text: Whistler (1.5 hour drive from Vancouver) is expensive but well-known because of the 2010 Winter Olympics.

text: Neguan, gozatu Ipar Amerikako eski onenaz, eta udan, probatu mendiko bizikletan ibiltzen.
eng_text: In the winter, enjoy some of the best skiing in North America, and in the summer try some authentic mountain biking.

text: Baimenak aurrez erreserbatu behar dira. Sirena-n gaua pasatzeko baimena eduki behar duzu.
eng_text: Permits must be reserved in advance. You must have a permit to stay overnight at Sirena.

text: Kanpatzeaz gain, Sirena da lotarako lekua eta otordu beroak eskaintzen dituen basozainen gune bakarra. La Leona, San Pedrillo eta Los Patos-ek kanpatzeko tokia eskaintzen dute, otordurik gabe.
eng_text: Sirena is the only ranger station that offers dormitory lodging and hot meals in addition to camping. La Leona, San Pedrillo, and Los Patos offer only camping with no food service.

text: Parkera sartzeko baimenak lortu daitezke zuzenean Puerto Jiménez-ko basozainen gunean, baina ez dute onartzen kreditu txartelik.
eng_text: It is possible to secure park permits directly from the Ranger Station in Puerto Jiménez, but they do not accept credit cards

text: Parkeko zerbitzuak (MINAE) ez ditu ematen parkera sartzeko baimenak iritsiera-data baino hilabete bat baino lehenago.
eng_text: The Park Service (MINAE) does not issue park permits more than one month in advance of anticipated arrival.

text: CafeNet El Sol-ek erreserbak egiteko zerbitzuak eskaintzen ditu 30 USD-tan, edo 10 USD-tan egun baterako txartelei dagokienez. Xehetasunak euren Corcovado orrian aurki ditzakezu.
eng_text: CafeNet El Sol offers a reservation service for a fee of US$30, or $10 for one-day passes; details on their Corcovado page.

text: Cook Uharteak uhartedi bat dira eta Zeelanda Berriarekin elkargo librea osatzen dute. Polinesian daude kokatuta, Hegoaldeko Ozeano Pazifikoaren erdian.
eng_text: The Cook Islands are an island country in free association with New Zealand, located in Polynesia, in the middle of the South Pacific Ocean.

text: 15 uharteko artxipielago bat da eta irlok 2,2 milioi kilometro karratutan daude banatuta ozeanoan.
eng_text: It is an archipelago with 15 islands spread out over 2.2 million km2 of ocean.

text: Hawaiiko ordu zona bera dute eta batzuetan “beheko Hawaii” deitzen zaie.
eng_text: With the same time zone as Hawaii, the islands are sometimes thought of as "Hawaii down under".

text: Txikiagoak diren arren, Hawaiiko adineko bisitari batzuei euren irla estatu bihurtu aurreko egoera gogorarazten die, turistentzako hotel erraldoi eta bestelako garapenik ez zegoenean.
eng_text: Though smaller, it reminds some elderly visitors of Hawaii before statehood without all the large tourist hotels and other development.

text: Cook uharteek ez dute hiririk, baina 15 uhartez osatuta daude. Handienak Rarotonga eta Aitutaki dira.
eng_text: The Cook Islands do not have any cities but are composed of 15 different islands. The main ones are Rarotonga and Aitutaki.

text: Garatutako herrialdeetan, maila altuko lotarako tokia eta gosaria eskaintzea arte bihurtu da nolabait.
eng_text: In developed countries today, providing deluxe bed and breakfasts has been raised to a sort of art-form.

text: Guztiaren gainetik, halako tokiak bi gauzaren inguruan lehiatzen dira: lotarako tokia eta gosaria.
eng_text: At the top end, B&Bs obviously compete mainly on two main things: bedding and breakfast.

text: Ondorioz, halako toki onenetan, luxuzko oheak, agian eskuz egindako ohazalak edo antigoaleko oheak aurki daitezke.
eng_text: Accordingly, at the finest such establishments one is apt to find the most luxurious bedding, maybe a handmade quilt or an antique bed.

text: Gosarietan, eskualdeko sasoiko gozoak edo anfitrioiaren plater berezia sar daitezke.
eng_text: Breakfast may include seasonal delights of the region or the host's speciality dish.

text: Lekuari dagokionez, antigoaleko altzairuak dituen eraikin historiko zahar bat izan behar du, ondo zaindutako lur eta igerilekuarekin.
eng_text: The setting might be an historic old building with antique furnishings, manicured grounds and a swimming pool.

text: Kotxean sartu eta bidaia luze bat egiteak xarma berezia dauka bere sinpletasunean.
eng_text: Getting into your own car and heading off on a long road trip has an intrinsic appeal in its simplicity.

text: Ibilgailu handietan ez bezala, ohituta egongo zara seguruenik zeure autoa gidatzen eta jakingo dituzu bere mugak.
eng_text: Unlike larger vehicles, you are probably already familiar with driving your car and know its limitations.

text: Kanpin-denda bat eremu pribatuan edo edozein tamainako herri batean muntatzeak nahi gabeko arreta erakar dezake.
eng_text: Setting up a tent on private property or in a town of any size can easily attract unwanted attention.

text: Laburbilduz, zeure autoa erabiltzea modu bikaina da errepidez bidaia bat egiteko baina ez da izaten “kanpatzeko” modu bat.
eng_text: In short, using your car is a great way to take a road trip but seldom in itself a way to "camp".

text: Autoan kanpatzea posible da furgoneta handi bat, kirol-ibilgailu utilitario bat, sedan bat edo familiar bat edukiz gero, eserlekuak beheratuta.
eng_text: Car camping is possible if you have a large minivan, SUV, Sedan or Station Wagon with seats that lay down.

text: Hotel batzuek lurrunezko trenen eta gurutzaontzien urrezko aroko ondareak dituzte; hau da, 19. edo 20. mende hasierako II. Mundu Gerra aurrekoak.
eng_text: Some hotels have a heritage from the golden age of steam railways and ocean liners; before the Second World War, in the 19th or early 20th centuries.

text: Jende aberatsa eta ospetsua geratzen zen hotel hauetan, baita otordu eta festa ederrak egiten zituzten ere.
eng_text: These hotels were where the rich and the famous of the day would stay, and often had fine dining and nightlife.

text: Tresna zaharrak, zerbitzu modernoen falta eta zahartasuna nolabait dotoreak dira eta hotelon nortasunaren parte dira.
eng_text: The old fashioned fittings, the lack of the latest amenities, and a certain graceful agedness are also part of their character.

text: Jabe pribatuak izan ohi dituzte, baina batzuetan gobernuburu edo beste agintariak ere ostatatzen dituzte.
eng_text: While they are usually privately owned, they sometimes accommodate visiting heads of state and other dignitaries.

text: Diru askoko bidaiariek munduari itzulia ematea kontuan har dezakete, gau batzuk hotel hauetan igarota.
eng_text: A traveller with piles of money might consider a round the world flight, broken up with stays in many of these hotels.

text: Ostatuen trukerako sarea erakunde bat da eta bidaiariak eta bisitan doazen tokikoak konektatzen ditu.
eng_text: A hospitality exchange network is the organization that connects travelers with locals in the cities they are going to visit.

text: Halako sare batean parte hartzeko, lineako inprimaki bat bete behar da; hala ere, sare batzuk egiaztapen osagarria eskaintzen edo eskatzen dute.
eng_text: Joining such a network usually just requires filling out an online form; although some networks offer or require additional verification.

text: Ondoren, erabilgarri dauden ostalarien zerrenda bat ematen da inprimatuta edo linean; are gehiago, beste bidaiarien erreferentziak eta iritziak ere izaten dituzte batzuetan.
eng_text: A listing of available hosts is then provided either in print and/or online, sometimes with references and reviews by other travelers.

text: Couchsurfing-a 2004ko urtarrilean sortu zen, ordenagailu-programatzaile Casey Fenton-ek Islandiarako hegaldi merke bat aurkitu baina lotarako tokirik ez zuenean.
eng_text: Couchsurfing was founded in January 2004 after computer programmer Casey Fenton found a cheap flight to Iceland but did not have a place to stay.

text: Bertako unibertsitateko ikasleei mezu elektronikoak bidali zizkien eta doako ostatua eskaintzen zioten mezu ugari jaso zituen.
eng_text: He emailed students at the local university and received an overwhelming number of offers for free accommodation.

text: Ostatuetan gazteak egon ohi dira, normalean hogei urte ingurukoak, baina zaharragoak ere aurki daitezke.
eng_text: Hostels cater primarily to young people – a typical guest is in their twenties – but you can often find older travellers there too.

text: Haurrak dituzten familiak ez dira ohikoak, baina ostatu batzuek onartzen dituzte gela pribatuetan.
eng_text: Families with children are a rare sight, but some hostels do allow them in private rooms.

text: Txinako Pekin hirian izango dira 2022ko Neguko Olinpiadak. Horrela, hura izango da bai udako bai neguko Olinpiadak antolatu dituen lehen hiria.
eng_text: The city of Beijing in China will be the host city of the Olympic Winter Games in 2022, which will make it the first city to have hosted both the summer and winter Olympics.

text: Pekinek hasierako eta amaierako ospakizunak eta barneko izotz jokoak aurkeztuko ditu.
eng_text: Beijing will host the opening and closing ceremonies and the indoor ice events.

text: Beste eski ekitaldi batzuk Taizincheng-eko eski eremuan egingo dira, Zhangjiakou-n, Pekindik 220 bat kilometrotara (140 milia).
eng_text: Other skiing events will be at the Taizicheng ski area in Zhangjiakou, about 220 km (140 miles) from Beijing.

text: Tenplu gehienetan urteroko jaialdi bat egiten da, azaroa amaieratik maiatza erdialdera arte, tenplu bakoitzaren urteko egutegiaren arabera.
eng_text: Most of the temples do have an Annual festival starting from November end to Mid of May, which varies according to each temple's annual calendar.

text: Tenpluetako jaialdien zatirik handiena tenpluaren buru den jainkoaren urteurrenaren edo tenpluarekin lotutako beste gertaera garrantzitsu baten zati gisa ospatzen da.
eng_text: Most of the temple festivals is celebrated as part of temple's anniversary or presiding deity's birthday or any other major event associated with the temple.

text: Kerala tenpluko jaialdiak oso interesgarriak dira ikusteko; besteak beste, apaindutako elefanteen prozesioak, tenpluko orkestra eta bestelako jaialdiak egoten dira.
eng_text: Kerala's temple festivals are very interesting to see, with regular procession of decorated elephants, temple orchestra and other festivities.

text: Nazioarteko azoka (normalean, Nazioarteko erakusketa edo Expo gisa ezagutzen zaio honi) artean eta zientzian oinarritutako nazioarteko jaialdi handia da.
eng_text: A World's Fair (commonly called World Exposition, or simply Expo) is large international festival of arts and sciences.

text: Parte hartzen duten herrialdeek artearekin eta hezkuntzarekin erlazionatutako erakusketak egiten dituzte pabilioi nazionaletan, munduko arazoak edo euren herrialdeko kultura edo historia erakusteko.
eng_text: Participating countries present artistic and educational displays in national pavilions to showcase world issues or their country's culture and history.

text: Barazkigintzan oinarritutako nazioarteko erakusketak ekitaldi espezializatuak dira, eta bertan, loreekin egindako diseinuak, lorategi botanikoak eta landareekin egindako beste edozer erakusten dira.
eng_text: International Horticultural Expositions are specialised events which showcase floral displays, botanical gardens and anything else to do with plants.

text: Teorian, urtero ospa daitezke (baldin eta herrialde desberdinetan egiten badira), baina praktikan ez da hala gertatzen.
eng_text: Although in theory they can take place annually (so long as they are in different countries), in practice they are not.

text: Ekitaldi hauek hiru eta sei hilabete bitarte irauten dute eta 50 hektarea baino gehiagoko eremuetan ospatzen dira.
eng_text: These events normally last anywhere between three and six months, and are held on sites no smaller than 50 hectares.

text: Hainbat film-formatu erabili dira urteetan zehar. Ohikoena 35 mm-koa da (36 x 24 mm negatiboa).
eng_text: There are many different film formats that have been used over the years. Standard 35 mm film (36 by 24 mm negative) is much the commonest.

text: Erraz samar ordez daiteke zintarik gabe geratzen bazara, eta uneko DSLRarekin alderagarria den erresoluzioa eskaintzen du.
eng_text: It can usually be replenished fairly easily if you run out, and gives resolution roughly comparable to a current DSLR.

text: Formatu ertaineko bideokamera batzuek 6 x 6 cm-ko formatua erabiltzen dute, zehatzago esanda, 56 x 56 mm-ko negatiboa.
eng_text: Some medium-format film cameras use a 6 by 6 cm format, more precisely a 56 by 56 mm negative.

text: Horrek 35 mm-ko batek baino lau aldiz erresoluzio gehiago ematen du (3136 mm2, 864 formatuarekin alderatuta).
eng_text: This gives resolution almost four times that of a 35 mm negative (3136 mm2 versus 864).

text: Fauna da elementu zailena argazkilarientzat eta zortea, pazientzia, esperientzia eta ekipamenduaren arteko konbinazio ona behar da horretarako.
eng_text: Wildlife is among the most challenging motifs for a photographer, and needs a combination of good luck, patience, experience and good equipment.

text: Animalien argazkilaritza ziurtzat jo ohi da, baina argazkilaritza orokorraren gisan, argazki batek milaka hitzen balioa du.
eng_text: Wildlife photography is often taken for granted, but like photography in general, a picture is worth a thousand words.

text: Animalien argazkilaritzan telefoto-lente luzeak behar dira, baina txori multzo batek edo izaki oso txikiek beste lente bat beharko dute.
eng_text: Wildlife photography often requires a long telephoto lens, though things like a flock of birds or a tiny creature need other lenses.

text: Animalia exotiko asko zailak dira aurkitzen eta parke batzuetan helburu komertzialetarako argazkiak ateratzeari buruzko arauak dituzte.
eng_text: Many exotic animals are hard to find, and parks sometimes have rules about taking photographs for commercial purposes.

text: Animalia basatiak lotsatiak edo erasokorrak izan daitezke. Ingurunea hotza, beroa edo kontrakoa izan daiteke.
eng_text: Wild animals might either be shy or aggressive. The environment might be cold, hot, or otherwise hostile.

text: Munduan 5.000 hizkuntza baino gehiago daude eta horietako hogeik 50 milioi hiztun edo gehiago dituzte.
eng_text: The world has over 5,000 different languages, including more than twenty with 50 million or more speakers.

text: Hitz idatziak ere errazago ulertu ohi dira esandakoak baino. Hori gertatzen da helbideekin, batzuetan zailak baitira ahoskatzen.
eng_text: Written words are often easier to understand than spoken words, also. This is especially true of addresses, which are often difficult to pronounce intelligibly.

text: Herrialde askok ingelesez ongi hitz egin dezakete, eta gehiagotan ingelesez apur bat jakitea ere espero daiteke, jende gaztearen artean batez ere.
eng_text: Many entire nations are completely fluent in English, and in even more you can expect a limited knowledge - especially among younger people.

text: Imajinatu Manchesterko, Bostongo, Jamaikako eta Sydneyko jendea Torontoko jatetxe batean afaltzen ari zarela.
eng_text: Imagine, if you will, a Mancunian, Bostonian, Jamaican and Sydneysider sitting around a table having dinner at a restaurant in Toronto.

text: Bakoitza bere jaioterriko istorioak kontatzen ari da, bakoitza bere azentuan eta tokiko hizkeran.
eng_text: They're regaling each other with stories from their hometowns, told in their distinct accents and local argot.

text: Supermerkatuetan janaria erostea izan ohi da elikatzeko modurik merkeena. Ezer kozinatzeko aukerarik ez baduzu, aurrez prestatutako janarira soilik mugatzen dira eskainitako aukerak.
eng_text: Buying food in supermarkets is usually the cheapest way to get fed. Without cooking opportunities, choices are however limited to ready-made food.

text: Gero eta supermerkatu gehiagotan, aurrez prestatutako elikagaien saila asko zabaldu da. Batzuek mikrouhin-labeak edo janaria berotzeko gailuak izaten dituzte ere.
eng_text: Increasingly supermarkets are getting a more varied section of ready-made food. Some even provide a microwave oven or other means to heat food.

text: Herrialde edo denda mota batzuetan, supermerkatuan kokatutako jatetxeren bat ere egoten da eta normalean informala eta merkea da.
eng_text: In some countries or types of stores there is at least one on-site restaurant, often a rather informal one with affordable prices.

text: Egin gidalerroen kopiak eta eraman itzazu zeurekin aseguratzailearekin harremanetan jartzeko informazioarekin batera.
eng_text: Make and carry copies of your policy and your insurer's contact details with you.

text: Aseguratzailearen helbide elektronikoa eta nazioarteko telefono-zenbakiak erakutsi behar dituzte argibideak edo baimenak lortzeko eta eskaerak egiteko.
eng_text: They need to show the insurer's e-mail address and international phone numbers for advice/authorizations and making claims.

text: Eraman beste kopia bat maletan eta eduki beste bat linean (bidali eranskina posta elektronikoz zeure buruari edo gorde ezazu “hodeian”).
eng_text: Have another copy in your luggage and online (e-mail to yourself with attachment, or stored in the "cloud").

text: Ordenagailu eramangarri edo tableta batekin bidaiatzen baduzu, gorde kopia bat bertako memorian edo diskoan (Internetik gabe atzigarria izan behar du).
eng_text: If traveling with a laptop or tablet, store a copy in its memory or disc (accessible without the internet).

text: Halaber, eman gidalerroen edo kontaktuaren kopiak bidelagunei eta etxetik lagundu nahi dizuten ingurukoei edo lagunei.
eng_text: Also give policy/contact copies to traveling companions and relatives or friends back home willing to help.

text: Altzeak ez dira arriskutsuak izatez, baina euren burua defendatuko dute arriskurik sumatzen badute.
eng_text: Moose (also known as elk) aren't inherently aggressive, but will defend themselves if they perceive a threat.

text: Jendeak altzeak arriskutsu gisa ikusten ez dituenean, gehiegi gertura daitezke eta euren burua arriskuan jartzen dute.
eng_text: When people don't see moose as potentially dangerous, they may approach too closely and put themselves at risk.

text: Edan alkoholdun edariak neurrian. Alkoholak desberdin eragiten digu eta garrantzitsua da zeure muga ezagutzea.
eng_text: Drink alcoholic drinks with moderation. Alcohol affects everyone differently, and knowing your limit is very important.

text: Gehiegi edateak epe luzeko osasun arazoak sor ditzake, adibidez, gibeleko mina, baita itsutasuna eta heriotza bera ere. Arriskua handitu egiten da legez kanpo ekoitzitako alkoholaren kasuan.
eng_text: Possible long term health events from excessive drinking can include liver damage and even blindness and death. The potential danger is increased when consuming illegally produced alcohol.

text: Legez kanpoko likoreek ezpurutasun arriskutsuak izan ditzakete, hala nola, metanola, zeinak itsutasuna edo heriotza eragin baitezakeen, baita dosi txikietan ere.
eng_text: Illegal spirits can contain various dangerous impurities including methanol, which can cause blindness or death even in small doses.

text: Betaurrekoak merkeagoak izan daitezke atzerrian, batez ere baliabide gutxiko herrialdeetan, eskulana merkeagoa baita.
eng_text: Eyeglasses can be cheaper in a foreign country, especially in low-income countries where labour costs are lower.

text: Bizi zaren tokian begiak aztertzea gomendatzen dizugu, batez ere, aseguruak ordaintzen badu, eta preskripzioa zurekin eramatea beste nonbait artxibatzeko.
eng_text: Consider getting an eye exam at home, especially if insurance covers it, and bringing the prescription along to be filed elsewhere.

text: Halako tokietan erabilgarri dauden gama altuko marken armazoiak bi arazo eduki ditzakete: batzuk faltsuak izan daitezke eta egiaz inportatutakoak garestiagoak izan daitezke etxean baino.
eng_text: High-end brand-name frames available in such areas may have two problems; some may be knock-offs, and the real imported ones may be more expensive than at home.

text: Kafea da munduan gehien salerosten den produktua eta, seguruenik, zeure eskualdean hainbat kafe mota egongo dira eskuragarri.
eng_text: Coffee is one of the world's most traded commodities, and you can probably find many types in your home region.

text: Hala ere, kafea edateko berezko mota ugari daude munduan, probatzea merezi dutenak.
eng_text: Nevertheless, there are many distinctive ways of drinking coffee around the world that are worth experiencing.

text: Hondoa lehor edo urez beteta duen arroila baten behealdera jaistea da arroila-jaitsiera.
eng_text: Canyoning (or: canyoneering) is about going in a bottom of a canyon, which is either dry or full of water.

text: Arroila-jaitsieran igeriketa, eskalada eta jauziak konbinatzen dira, baina ez da trebakuntza handirik edo sasoi fisiko berezirik behar hasteko (adibidez eskaladarekin, urpekaritzarekin edo eskiarekin alderatuta).
eng_text: Canyoning combines elements from swimming, climbing and jumping--but requires relatively little training or physical shape to get started (compared to rock climbing, scuba diving or alpine skiing, for example).

text: Xendazaletasuna kanpoko jarduera bat da eta inguru naturaletan ibilaldiak egitean datza, maiz mendiko ibilbideetan.
eng_text: Hiking is an outdoor activity which consists of walking in natural environments, often on hiking trails.

text: Eguneko xendazaletasunaren barruan, milia bat baino gutxiagoko distantziak edo egun batean egin daitekeen distantziak hartzen dira barne.
eng_text: Day hiking involves distances of less than a mile up to longer distances that can be covered in a single day.

text: Egun batez bide erraz batean ibiltzeko ez da prestakuntza handirik behar eta egoera on samarrean dagoen edonork goza dezake.
eng_text: For a day hike along an easy trail little preparations are needed, and any moderately fit person can enjoy them.

text: Haur txikiak dituzten familiek prestakuntza handiagoa behar dute baina egun bat kanpoan igarotzea posible da haurtxoak eta ume txikiak izanik ere.
eng_text: Families with small children may need more preparations, but a day outdoors is easily possible even with babies and pre-school children.

text: Nazioartean, korrikan egiteko bisitaldiak antolatzen dituzten 200 erakunde inguru daude. Gehienek modu independentean egiten dute lan.
eng_text: Internationally, there are nearly 200 running tour organizations. Most of them operate independently.

text: Global Running Tours-en ondorengo Go Running Tours-ek korrikan egiteko bisitaldiak antolatzen dituzten lau kontinenteetako eragile ugari konektatzen ditu.
eng_text: The Global Running Tours successor, Go Running Tours networks dozens of sightrunning providers on four continents.

text: Bartzelonako Running Tours Barcelona eta Kopenhageko Running Copenhagen sortu ondoren, Pragako Running Tours Prague eta beste asko batu zitzaizkien.
eng_text: With roots in Barcelona's Running Tours Barcelona and Copenhagen's Running Copenhagen, it was quickly joined by Running Tours Prague based in Prague and others.

text: Kontuan hartzeko gauza asko daude norabait bidaiatu aurretik eta bidaian bertan.
eng_text: There are many things you have to take into consideration before and when you travel somewhere.

text: Bidaiatzerakoan, ez espero gauzak “etxean bezalakoak” izatea. Jokamoldeak, legeak, janaria, trafikoa, ostatuak, irizpideak, hizkuntza eta abar desberdinak izango dira zeure bizitokiarekin alderatuta.
eng_text: When you travel, expect things not to be like they are "back home". Manners, laws, food, traffic, lodging, standards, language and so on will to some extent differ from where you live.

text: Hori kontuan hartzeko zerbait da, desilusioa edo baita bertako gauzak egiteko modua ez gustatzea ekiditeko.
eng_text: This is something you always need to keep in mind, to avoid disappointment or perhaps even distaste over local ways to do things.

text: Bidaia-agentziak lanean aritu dira 19. mendetik. Bidaia-agentziak aukera ona dira, bidaiariak naturarekin, kulturarekin, hizkuntzarekin edo baliabide gutxiko herrialdeekin lotuta izan dezakeen esperientziatik harago joaten direlako.
eng_text: Travel agencies have been around since the 19th century. A travel agent is usually a good option for a journey which extends beyond a traveller's previous experience of nature, culture, language or low-income countries.

text: Bidaia-agentzia gehienek ohiko erreserbak hartzen dituzte, baina badaude bidaia, aurrekontu edo helmuga berezietan espezializatutako agentziak ere.
eng_text: Although most agencies are willing to take on most regular bookings, many agents specialise in particular types of travel, budget ranges or destinations.

text: Hobea izan daiteke zeurearen antzeko bidaiak antolatzen dituen agentziaren bat erabiltzea.
eng_text: It can be better to use an agent who frequently books similar trips to yours.

text: Eman begiratua agentziaren eskaintzei euren webgunean edo erakusleihoetan.
eng_text: Take a look at what trips the agent is promoting, whether on a website or in a shop window.

text: Modu merkean edo beharragatik, bizi-estiloa aldatzeagatik edo erronka bati aurre egiteagatik ikusi nahi baduzu mundua, badaude hori egiteko hainbat modu.
eng_text: If you want to see the world on the cheap, for necessity, lifestyle or challenge, there are some ways to do that.

text: Funtsean, bi kategoriatan banatzen dira: bidaiatu bitartean lan egitea edo zeure aurrezkiak mugatzea. Artikulu honek bigarren kategoriari buruz hitz egiten du.
eng_text: Basically, they fall into two categories: Either work while you travel or try and limit your expenses. This article is focused on the latter.

text: Ia ezer xahutze aldera erosotasuna, denbora eta aurreikusteko gaitasuna sakrifikatzeko prest dauden horientzat, ikusi aurrekontu txikieneko bidaiak.
eng_text: For those willing to sacrifice comfort, time and predictability to push expenses down close to zero, see minimum budget travel.

text: Gomendioak ziurtzat hartzen du bidaiariek ez dutela lapurtzen, ez direla inora baimenik gabe sartzen, ez dutela legez kanpoko merkatuan parte hartzen, ez direla eskean ibiltzen edo ez dutela euren mesederako jendea esplotatzen.
eng_text: The advice assumes that travellers do not steal, trespass, participate in the illegal market, beg, or otherwise exploit other people for their own gain.

text: Immigrazio-kontrola da hegazkin, ontzi edo beste ibilgailu batetik atera ondorengo lehen geldialdia.
eng_text: An immigration checkpoint is usually the first stop when disembarking from a plane, a ship, or another vehicle.

text: Tren mugakideetan ikuskapenak egiten dira trena martxan dagoen bitartean eta balio duen nortasun-agiri bat eduki behar duzu halako trenetara igotzean.
eng_text: In some cross-border trains inspections are done on the running train and you should have valid ID with you when boarding one of those trains.

text: Lotarako trenetan, gidariak pasaporteak jaso ditzake, lo egin bitartean bidaiariak ez eragozteko.
eng_text: On night sleeper trains, passports may be collected by the conductor so that you do not have your sleep interrupted.

text: Bisa bat lortzeko prozesuan, erregistratu ere egin behar da. Herrialde batzuetan, zeure presentzia eta ostatuaren helbidea erregistratu behar dituzu tokiko agintaritzan.
eng_text: Registration is an additional requirement for the visa process. In some countries, you must register your presence and address where you are staying with the local authorities.

text: Baliteke tokiko poliziarekin inprimaki bat bete edo immigrazio-bulegora joan behar izatea.
eng_text: This might require filling out a form with the local police or a visit to the immigration offices.

text: Halako legeak dituzten herrialdeetan, tokiko hotelek egingo dute erregistroa (ziurtatu hori egiteko eskatzen duzula).
eng_text: In many countries with such a law, local hotels will handle the registration (make sure to ask).

text: Bestelako kasuetan, turistentzako ostatuetan geratzen ez diren turistek soilik erregistratu behar dute. Hala ere, horrek legea zailtzen duenez, informa zaitez lehenago.
eng_text: In other cases, only those staying outside of tourist accommodations need to register.  However, this makes the law much more obscure, so find out beforehand.

text: Eraikinen diseinuaz eta eraikuntzaz arduratzen da arkitektura. Batzuetan, lekuko arkitektura turistentzako erakargarria izan ohi da bere horretan.
eng_text: Architecture is concerned with the design and construction of buildings. The architecture of a place is often a tourist attraction in its own right.

text: Zenbait eraikin ederrak dira ikusteko eta eraikin altu batetik edo modu adimentsuan jarritako leiho batetik ikuspegi bikainak lor daitezke.
eng_text: Many buildings are quite beautiful to look at and the view from a tall building or from a cleverly-positioned window can be a beauty to behold.

text: Arkitektura gainjarri egiten da beste arlo batzuekin; besteak beste, hiri-plangintza, ingeniaritza zibila, dekorazio-arte, barne-diseinu eta lorategi-diseinuarekin.
eng_text: Architecture overlaps considerably with other fields including urban planning, civil engineering, decorative arts, interior design and landscape design.

text: Kontuan hartuta herrietako batzuk zein isolatuta dauden, ezin izango duzu gaugiro handirik aurkitu Albuquerque edo Santa Fe-ra joaten ez bazara.
eng_text: Given how remote many of the pueblos are, you won't be able to find a significant amount of nightlife without traveling to Albuquerque or Santa Fe.

text: Hala ere, goian zerrendatutako kasino gehienek edariak zerbitzatzen dituzte eta horietako batzuk markek eskainitako entretenimendua eskaintzen dute (batez ere Albuquerque eta Santa Fe inguruko markak).
eng_text: However, nearly all of the casinos listed above serve drinks, and several of them bring in name-brand entertainment (primarily the large ones immediately surrounding Albuquerque and Santa Fe).

text: Kontuan izan: herri txikietako tabernak ez dira beti egoteko tokirik egokiak kanpotarrentzat.
eng_text: Beware: small-town bars here are not always good places for the out-of-state visitor to hang out.

text: Lehenik, Mexiko Berriaren iparraldeak mozkortuta gidatzearekin lotutako arazo handiak ditu eta mozkortuta dauden gidarien kontzentrazioa herri txikietako tabernetakoaren antzekoa da.
eng_text: For one thing, northern New Mexico has significant problems with drunk driving, and the concentration of intoxicated drivers is high close to small-town bars.

text: Nahi gabeko horma-irudiak edo zirriborroak graffiti gisa ezagutzen dira.
eng_text: Unwanted murals or scribble is known as graffiti.

text: Nahiz eta fenomeno moderno izatetik urrun egon, gehienek espraiak erabiliz jabetza publikoa eta pribatua hondatzen duten gazteekin erlazionatzen dute.
eng_text: While it's far from a modern phenomenon, most people probably associate it with youth vandalizing public and private property using spray paint.

text: Hala ere, gaur egun graffiti artista errespetatuak, graffitiarekin lotutako ekitaldiak eta “legezko” hormak daude. Testuinguru horretan, graffitiak artelanak dira etiketa irakurtezinak baino.
eng_text: However, nowadays there are established graffiti artists, graffiti events and "legal" walls. Graffiti paintings in this context often resemble artworks rather than illegible tags.

text: Bumerana jaurtitzeko gaitasuna turista askok lortu nahiko luketen abilezia ezaguna da.
eng_text: Boomerang throwing is a popular skill that many tourists want to acquire.

text: Eskura itzultzen den bumerana jaurtitzen ikasi nahi baduzu, ziurtatu itzultzeko egokia den bumeran bat duzula.
eng_text: If you want to learn throwing a boomerang that comes back to your hand, make sure you have a suitable boomerang for returning.

text: Izan ere, Australian erabilgarri dauden bumeran gehienak ez dira itzultzen. Hasiberrientzat, hobe da bumerana botatzen ez saiatzea haizea badabil.
eng_text: Most boomerangs available in Australia are in fact non-returning. It is best for beginners to not try throwing in windy

text: Hangi otordua lurrean egiten da, zulo bero batean.
eng_text: A Hangi Meal is cooked in a hot pit in the ground.

text: Zuloa sutan egondako harri beroekin edo berotasun geotermikoarekin berotzen da, zeinak lurreko eremuak naturalki berotzen baitituen.
eng_text: The pit is either heated with hot stones from a fire, or in some places geothermal heat makes areas of ground naturally hot.

text: Hangia erabili ohi da erretako jakiak dituen afari tradizionalak egiteko.
eng_text: The hangi is often used to cook a traditional roast style dinner.

text: Rotorua-ko hainbat tokitan hangi geotermikoa eskaintzen dute eta beste batzuk proba daitezke Christchurch, Wellington edo beste tokietan.
eng_text: Several places in Rotorua offer geothermal hangi, while other hangi can be sampled in Christchurch, Wellington and elsewhere.

text: MetroRai-ek bi klase ditu Lurmutur Hiriaren barruko eta inguruko trenetan: MetroPlus (lehenengo klasea ere deitua) eta Metro (hirugarren klasea ere deitua).
eng_text: MetroRail has two classes on commuter trains in and around Cape Town: MetroPlus (also called First Class) and Metro (called Third Class).

text: MetroPlus erosoagoa da eta bidaiari gutxiago ditu, baina apur bat garestiagoa da. Hala ere, Europako metroetako txartel arruntak baino merkeagoa da.
eng_text: MetroPlus is more comfortable and less crowded but slightly more expensive, though still cheaper than normal metro tickets in Europe.

text: Tren guztietan daude MetroPlus eta Metro eserlekuak; MetroPlus eserlekuak Lurmutur Hiritik gertuen dagoen trenaren amaieran daude.
eng_text: Every train has both MetroPlus and Metro coaches; the MetroPlus coaches are always on the end of the train nearest Cape Town.

text: Besteen gauzak eramatea: ez galdu maletak bistatik, batez ere nazioarteko mugak igarotzean.
eng_text: Carrying for others - Never let your bags out of your sight, especially when you are crossing international borders.

text: Drogak garraiatzeko erabil zaitzakete zeuk jakin gabe eta horrek sekulako arazoetan sar zaitzake.
eng_text: You could find yourself being used as a drug carrier without your knowledge, which will land you in a great deal of trouble.

text: Hori kontuan hartu ilaran itxarotean, droga usaintzen duten txakurrak edonoiz erabili ahal baitituzte abisatu gabe.
eng_text: This includes waiting in line, as drug-sniffing dogs could be used at any time without notice.

text: Herrialde batzuetan oso zigor gogorrak dituzte, baita inoiz egindako lehen delitua bada ere. 10 urteko kartzela-zigorra edo heriotza-zigorra ere aplika daiteke.
eng_text: Some countries have exceedingly draconian punishments even for first time offenses; these can include prison sentences of over 10 years or death.

text: Zaindu gabeko poltsak dira lapurren helburu eta lehergailu-mehatxuak jarraitzen dituzten agintaritzen arreta ere erakar dezakete.
eng_text: Unattended bags are a target for theft and can also attract attention from authorities wary of bomb threats.

text: Etxean, tokiko germenen etengabeko esposizioagatik, oso litekeena da horiei immune izatea.
eng_text: At home, due to this constant exposure to the local germs, odds are very high that you're already immune to them.

text: Baina munduko beste zenbait tokitan, fauna bakteriologikoa berria da eta aukera gehiago dituzu arazoak izateko.
eng_text: But in other parts of the world, where the bacteriological fauna are new to you, you're far more likely to run into problems.

text: Halaber, klima beroagoetan, bakterioak azkarrago hazten dira eta denbora luzeagoz bizirauten dute gorputzetik kanpo.
eng_text: Also, in warmer climates bacteria both grow more quickly and survive longer outside the body.

text: Hortik datoz Delhi Belly-ren zartailuak, Faraoiaren madarikazioa, Montezuma-ren mendekua eta euren hainbat lagun.
eng_text: Thus the scourges of Delhi Belly, the Pharaoh's Curse, Montezuma's Revenge, and their many friends.

text: Klima hotzagoetan izaten diren arnasketa-arazoen antzera, hesteetako arazoak nahiko ohikoak dira klima beroetan. Gehienetan oso desatseginak izaten dira, baina ez dira oso arriskutsuak.
eng_text: As with respiratory problems in colder climates, intestinal problems in hot climates are fairly common and in most cases are distinctly annoying but not really dangerous.

text: Garapen bidean dagoen herrialde bat –edo munduko leku berri batean dagoen herrialde bat– lehen aldiz bisitatzerakoan, ez gutxietsi shock kulturala.
eng_text: If traveling in a developing country for the first time – or in a new part of the world – don't underestimate the potential culture shock.

text: Bidaiari egonkor eta trebe bat baino gehiagori egin dio gainezka garapen bidean dagoen herrialderen batera bidaiatzearen berritasunak, ezin direlako kulturara azkar egokitu.
eng_text: Many a stable, capable traveler has been overcome by the newness of developing world travel, where many little cultural adjustments can add up quickly.

text: Batez ere egunetan, mendebaldeko estilo eta kalitateko hoteletan, otorduetan eta zerbitzuetan gastatzea gomendatzen dizugu, egokitzen lagun zaitzaten.
eng_text: Especially in your initial days, consider splurging on Western-style and -quality hotels, food, and services to help acclimatize.

text: Ez egin lo lurrean ipinitako koltxoietan bertako fauna ezagutzen ez baduzu.
eng_text: Do not sleep on a mattress or pad on the ground in areas where you do not know the local fauna.

text: Kanpoan kanpatzeko asmoa baduzu, eraman kanpineko etzaleku edo hamaka bat, suge, eskorpioi eta halakoengandik urrun egoteko.
eng_text: If you are going to camp out, bring a camp cot or hammock to keep you away from snakes, scorpions and such.

text: Bete etxea goizean kafe gozoz eta kamamila-te lasaigarriz gauean.
eng_text: Fill your home with a rich coffee in the morning and some relaxing chamomile tea at night.

text: Oporrak etxean igarotzean, zeure burua zaintzeko eta zerbait berezia prestatzeko minutu batzuk gehiago hartzeko denbora duzu.
eng_text: When you're on a staycation, you have the time to treat yourself and take a few extra minutes to brew up something special.

text: Abenturarako gogoz bazaude, egin zukua edo irabiakiak.
eng_text: If you're feeling more adventurous, take the opportunity to juice or blend up some smoothies:

text: agian errutinara bueltatzen zarenean gosaltzeko egin dezakezun edari sinpleren bat sortuko duzu.
eng_text: maybe you'll discover a simple beverage that you can make for breakfast when you're back to your daily routine.

text: Edanaren inguruko askotariko kulturak dituen hiri batean bizi bazara, bisitatu joaten ez zaren auzoetako tabernaren bat.
eng_text: If you live in a city with a varied drinking culture, go to bars or pubs in neighborhoods you don't frequent.

text: Hizkuntza-medikoa ezagutzen ez duten horientzat, infekzioso eta kutsakor hitzek esanahi desberdina dute.
eng_text: For those unfamiliar with medical jargon, the words infectious and contagious have distinct meanings.

text: Gaixotasun infekziosoak patogenoek sortutakoak dira, hala nola, birusek, bakterioek, onddoek edo bestelako parasitoek.
eng_text: An infectious disease is one that is caused by a pathogen, such as a virus, bacterium, fungus or other parasites.

text: Gaixotasun kutsakorrak dira infektatuta dagoen norbaitengana gerturatuta erraz transmititzen direnak.
eng_text: A contagious disease is a disease which is easily transmitted by being in the vicinity of an infected person.

text: Gobernu askok eskatzen diete herrialdera datozen bidaiariei edo atzerrira doazen egoiliarrei hainbat gaixotasunen aurkako txertoa jartzea.
eng_text: Many governments require visitors entering, or residents leaving, their countries to be vaccinated for a range of diseases.

text: Eskakizun horiek aldatu egin daitezke bidaiariak bisitatu dituen edo bisitatu nahi dituen herrialdeen aranera.
eng_text: These requirements may often depend on what countries a traveller has visited or intends to visit.

text: Familientzako kalitate handiko aukera ugari edukitzea da Charlotteren (Ipar Carolina) ezaugarri onenetakoa.
eng_text: One of strong points of Charlotte, North Carolina, is that it has an abundance of high-quality options for families.

text: Beste toki batzuetako bizilagunek diote familientzako leku egokia dela hara bizitzera joateko arrazoi nagusia, eta bisitariei hiri atsegina iruditzen zaie haurrekin bisitatzeko.
eng_text: Residents from other areas often cite family-friendliness as a primary reason for moving there, and visitors often find the city easy to enjoy with children around.
